```{=html}
        "domain_label": "Education & Gender Demographics",
        "source_document": "KNBS (2023) County Gender Data Sheet, p. 6",
        "official_definition": "Gender Parity Index for secondary school Net Attendance Ratio (official secondary school age attendance; 1.0 = parity).",
        "unit": " GPI",
        "maxScale": 2.0,
        "directionality": "neutral",
        "directionality_rationale": "Demographic equity benchmark for age-appropriate secondary school attendance.",
        "climate_relevance": "Benchmarks age-appropriate secondary education equity; deviations reveal structural gender imbalances in adolescent schooling.",
        "guidance": "Support community boarding schools with safe water and solar power to ensure uninterrupted education during droughts."
      }
    };

    // The Curated 10 Key Climate Vulnerability Subset
    const CLIMATE_KEY_INDICATORS = [
      "water_time_burden",
      "food_insecurity",
      "undernutrition_f",
      "undernutrition_m",
      "health_access_barrier",
      "water_access_30m",
      "sanitation_unshared",
      "clean_cooking",
      "literacy_f",
      "child_marriage_f"
    ];

    const COUNTY_HURUMAP_SLUGS = {
      "Mombasa": "county-1-mombasa", "Kwale": "county-2-kwale", "Kilifi": "county-3-kilifi", "Tana River": "county-4-tana-river",
      "Lamu": "county-5-lamu", "Taita Taveta": "county-6-taita-taveta", "Garissa": "county-7-garissa", "Wajir": "county-8-wajir",
      "Mandera": "county-9-mandera", "Marsabit": "county-10-marsabit", "Isiolo": "county-11-isiolo", "Meru": "county-12-meru",
      "Tharaka-Nithi": "county-13-tharaka-nithi", "Embu": "county-14-embu", "Kitui": "county-15-kitui", "Machakos": "county-16-machakos",
      "Makueni": "county-17-makueni", "Nyandarua": "county-18-nyandarua", "Nyeri": "county-19-nyeri", "Kirinyaga": "county-20-kirinyaga",
      "Muranga": "county-21-muranga", "Murang'a": "county-21-muranga", "Kiambu": "county-22-kiambu", "Turkana": "county-23-turkana",
      "West Pokot": "county-24-west-pokot", "Samburu": "county-25-samburu", "Trans Nzoia": "county-26-trans-nzoia",
      "Uasin Gishu": "county-27-uasin-gishu", "Elgeyo Marakwet": "county-28-elgeyo-marakwet", "Nandi": "county-29-nandi",
      "Baringo": "county-30-baringo", "Laikipia": "county-31-laikipia", "Nakuru": "county-32-nakuru", "Narok": "county-33-narok",
      "Kajiado": "county-34-kajiado", "Kericho": "county-35-kericho", "Bomet": "county-36-bomet", "Kakamega": "county-37-kakamega",
      "Vihiga": "county-38-vihiga", "Bungoma": "county-39-bungoma", "Busia": "county-40-busia", "Siaya": "county-41-siaya",
      "Kisumu": "county-42-kisumu", "Homa Bay": "county-43-homa-bay", "Migori": "county-44-migori", "Kisii": "county-45-kisii",
      "Nyamira": "county-46-nyamira", "Nairobi": "county-47-nairobi"
    };

    function getCountyProfileUrl(c) {
      const slug = COUNTY_HURUMAP_SLUGS[c] || `county-${String(c).toLowerCase().replace(/['\s]+/g, '-')}`;
      return `https://kenya.hurumap.org/profiles/${slug}/`;
    }

    let currentGesiCountyName = 'Marsabit';
    let activeGesiDomain = 'climate_key';
    let currentSelectedIndicatorId = 'water_time_burden';
    let currentGesiPlotType = 'dumbbell';
    let currentGesiPalette = 'atlas';
    let currentGesiDensity = 'normal';
    let currentGesiView = 'plot';

    function getActiveIndicatorList() {
      if (activeGesiDomain === 'climate_key') {
        return CLIMATE_KEY_INDICATORS.map(id => FULL_35_GESI_DB[id]);
      } else if (activeGesiDomain === 'all') {
        return Object.values(FULL_35_GESI_DB);
      } else {
        return Object.values(FULL_35_GESI_DB).filter(d => d.domain === activeGesiDomain);
      }
    }

    function filterGesiDomain(domain, btnElement) {
      activeGesiDomain = domain;
      const pills = document.querySelectorAll('#gesiDomainPills .domain-pill');
      pills.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      if (btnElement) btnElement.classList.add('active');

      const list = getActiveIndicatorList();
      if (!list.some(d => d.id === currentSelectedIndicatorId)) {
        currentSelectedIndicatorId = list[0].id;
        updateGesiImplicationCard(list[0]);
      }

      renderMultiIndicatorPlot();
      renderMultiIndicatorTable();
    }

    function selectIndicatorRow(id) {
      currentSelectedIndicatorId = id;
      const data = FULL_35_GESI_DB[id];
      if (data) {
        updateGesiImplicationCard(data);
      }
      renderMultiIndicatorPlot();
    }

    function updateGesiImplicationCard(data) {
      const cardContainer = document.querySelector('.statutory-knbs-implication-card');
      if (!cardContainer) return;
      
      const hasVal = data.countyVal != null && !Number.isNaN(data.countyVal);
      const cVal = hasVal ? data.countyVal : null;
      const cRank = (hasVal && data.countyRank != null) ? data.countyRank : null;
      const county = (typeof currentGesiCountyName !== 'undefined' && currentGesiCountyName) ? currentGesiCountyName : 'Marsabit';
      const diff = hasVal ? Math.round((cVal - data.natAvg) * 10) / 10 : null;
      const diffSign = (diff != null && diff > 0) ? '+' : '';
      
      let dirBadge = '';
      if (data.directionality === 'neutral') {
        dirBadge = `<span class="dir-badge neutral" style="background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.78rem;">Directionality: Neutral Demographic Metric</span>`;
      } else if (data.directionality === 'lower_is_better') {
        dirBadge = `<span class="dir-badge lower" style="background: #fef2f2; color: #991b1b; border: 1px solid #fecaca; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.78rem;">Directionality: Lower is Desirable (Deficit / Vulnerability when High)</span>`;
      } else {
        dirBadge = `<span class="dir-badge higher" style="background: #ecfdf5; color: #065f46; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.78rem;">Directionality: Higher is Desirable (Asset / Advantage when High)</span>`;
      }

      const valDisplay = hasVal ? `${cVal}${data.unit}` : `<span style="font-weight: normal; font-style: italic; color: #64748b;">Not available in sheet</span>`;
      const rankDisplay = hasVal ? `#${cRank} of 47 Counties` : `<span style="font-style: italic; color: #64748b;">Not available for ${county}</span>`;
      const profileUrl = getCountyProfileUrl(county);

      cardContainer.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.55rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 0.5rem;">
          <div>
            <h4 style="margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #0f172a; font-weight: 800;">
              ${data.name} &bull; ${county} (${valDisplay}) vs Kenya Benchmark (${data.natAvg}${data.unit})
            </h4>
            <div style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: #64748b; margin-top: 0.25rem; display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;">
              <span><strong>KNBS Code:</strong> <code>${data.code}${data.sub ? ` (${data.sub})` : ''}</code> &bull; <strong>Source:</strong> <em>${data.source_document}</em> &bull; <strong>National Rank:</strong> ${rankDisplay}</span>
              <a class="gesi-county-profile-link" href="${profileUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #0284c7; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline;">Official KNBS ${county} Profile &rarr;</a>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>${dirBadge}</div>
        </div>

        <div style="background: #f8fafc; border-left: 4px solid #0284c7; padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 4px; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.45; color: #1e293b;">
          <strong style="color: #0369a1; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.2rem;">Official Survey Indicator Definition:</strong>
          "${data.official_definition}"
        </div>

        <div style="background: #fcfbf7; border: 1px solid #e8e2d4; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.45; color: #44403c;">
          <strong style="color: #78350f; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.2rem;">Climate Transmission &amp; Vulnerability Mechanism:</strong>
          ${data.climate_relevance}
        </div>

        <div class="knbs-action-guidance" style="background: #eff6ff; border-left: 4px solid #2563eb; padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.83rem; line-height: 1.45; color: #1e3a8a;">
          <strong style="color: #1d4ed8; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.2rem;">Recommended Adaptation Planning Guidance (CIDP &amp; Project Design):</strong>
          ${data.guidance}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    window.updateGesiWithLiveSeries = function(countyName, liveSeries) {
      if (countyName) currentGesiCountyName = countyName;

      // 1. Clear prior county values from ALL 35 indicators (never leak across county switch)
      Object.values(FULL_35_GESI_DB).forEach(ind => {
        delete ind.countyVal;
        delete ind.countyRank;
      });

      // 2. Reactively update labels
      const legendLabel = document.getElementById('gesi-legend-county-label');
      if (legendLabel) legendLabel.textContent = `${currentGesiCountyName} County Value`;
      const thCounty = document.getElementById('gesi-th-county-val');
      if (thCounty) thCounty.textContent = `${currentGesiCountyName} Value`;
      const csvBtn = document.getElementById('gesi-dl-csv-btn');
      if (csvBtn) csvBtn.textContent = `Data Rows (CSV - ${currentGesiCountyName} vs Nat Avg)`;

      // Dynamic official KNBS county profile link
      const profileLink = document.getElementById('gesiCountyProfileLink');
      if (profileLink && currentGesiCountyName) {
        profileLink.href = getCountyProfileUrl(currentGesiCountyName);
        profileLink.innerHTML = `Official KNBS Profile for ${currentGesiCountyName} &rarr;`;
      }

      // 3. Robust code + sub matching against liveSeries
      if (liveSeries && liveSeries.length) {
        Object.values(FULL_35_GESI_DB).forEach(ind => {
          const rec = liveSeries.find(s => {
            if (!s.code || s.code !== ind.code) return false;
            if (ind.sub) {
              return s.sub === ind.sub;
            } else {
              return !s.sub || s.sub === 'None';
            }
          });

          if (rec && rec.cv != null) {
            ind.countyVal = +rec.cv.toFixed(1);
            if (rec.kenya != null) ind.natAvg = +rec.kenya.toFixed(1);
            if (rec.rank != null) ind.countyRank = rec.rank;
          } else {
            ind.countyVal = null;
            ind.countyRank = null;
          }
        });
      }

      renderMultiIndicatorPlot();
      renderMultiIndicatorTable();
      if (typeof currentSelectedIndicatorId !== 'undefined' && currentSelectedIndicatorId) {
        const curInd = FULL_35_GESI_DB[currentSelectedIndicatorId];
        if (curInd) updateGesiImplicationCard(curInd);
      }
    };

    function renderMultiIndicatorPlot() {
      const container = document.getElementById('gesi-plot-canvas');
      if (!container) return;
      const indicators = getActiveIndicatorList();
      const activeCounty = (typeof currentGesiCountyName !== 'undefined' && currentGesiCountyName) ? currentGesiCountyName : 'Marsabit';

      let html = '';
      indicators.forEach(d => {
        const isSelected = d.id === currentSelectedIndicatorId;
        const selectedClass = isSelected ? 'selected-row' : '';

        const hasVal = d.countyVal != null && !Number.isNaN(d.countyVal);
        const cVal = hasVal ? d.countyVal : null;
        const cRank = (hasVal && d.countyRank != null) ? d.countyRank : null;

        let maxScale = d.maxScale || 100;
        const natPos = Math.min(98, Math.max(2, (d.natAvg / maxScale) * 100));

        if (!hasVal) {
          html += `
            <div class="indicator-plot-row ${selectedClass}" onclick="selectIndicatorRow('${d.id}')" title="Click to inspect KNBS indicator profile">
              <div class="row-label-col">
                <div class="row-label-domain">${d.domain_label}</div>
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px;">
                  <span>${d.name}</span>
                  <span class="enso-tooltip-wrap" onclick="event.stopPropagation();">
                    <span class="enso-tooltip-icon" tabindex="0" title="${d.climate_relevance ? d.climate_relevance.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') : 'Climate transmission mechanism'}">ℹ</span>
                    <span class="enso-tooltip-bubble"><strong>Why this matters:</strong> ${d.climate_relevance ? d.climate_relevance.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') : d.directionality_rationale}</span>
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-gauge-col">
                <div class="gauge-track" style="background:#f1f5f9; border: 1px dashed #cbd5e1; display:flex; align-items:center;">
                  <div class="gauge-marker-nat" style="left: ${natPos}%;" title="Kenya National Benchmark: ${d.natAvg}${d.unit}"></div>
                  <span style="font-size: 0.7rem; color: #94a3b8; font-style: italic; padding-left: 6px;">Not available in sheet for ${activeCounty}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-values-col">
                <div class="val-county" style="font-weight: 600; color: #94a3b8; font-style: italic;">Not available</div>
                <div class="val-nat" style="color: #64748b; font-size: 0.72rem;">Nat: ${d.natAvg}${d.unit}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-rank-col">
                <span class="rank-badge rank-tier-neutral" style="background:#f1f5f9; color:#64748b; border:1px solid #cbd5e1;" title="No recorded county data">Rank —/47</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          `;
          return;
        }

        const countyPos = Math.min(98, Math.max(2, (cVal / maxScale) * 100));
        const minPos = Math.min(natPos, countyPos);
        const spanWidth = Math.abs(countyPos - natPos);

        const diff = Math.round((cVal - d.natAvg) * 10) / 10;
        const absDiff = Math.abs(diff);
        const diffSign = diff > 0 ? '+' : '';

        const relGap = d.natAvg > 0.001 ? (absDiff / d.natAvg) : (absDiff > 0 ? 1 : 0);

        let gapType = 'neutral';
        if (d.directionality === 'neutral') {
          gapType = 'neutral';
        } else if (absDiff < 0.2 || (relGap < 0.03 && spanWidth < 1.0)) {
          gapType = 'neutral';
        } else if (d.directionality === 'lower_is_better') {
          gapType = diff > 0 ? 'adverse' : 'favorable';
        } else {
          gapType = diff > 0 ? 'favorable' : 'adverse';
        }

        let severityLevel = 1;
        if (relGap >= 0.75 || spanWidth >= 20) {
          severityLevel = 4;
        } else if (relGap >= 0.40 || spanWidth >= 10) {
          severityLevel = 3;
        } else if (relGap >= 0.15 || spanWidth >= 4) {
          severityLevel = 2;
        } else {
          severityLevel = 1;
        }

        let countyDotColor = '#0284c7';
        let spanColor = '#94a3b8';
        let diffTextColor = '#64748b';
        let gapLabel = 'Benchmark Match';

        if (d.directionality === 'neutral') {
          spanColor = '#94a3b8';
          diffTextColor = '#475569';
          gapLabel = 'Neutral Demographic Characteristic';
        } else if (currentGesiPalette === 'mono') {
          countyDotColor = '#0f172a';
          if (gapType === 'neutral') {
            spanColor = '#cbd5e1';
            diffTextColor = '#64748b';
          } else if (severityLevel === 4) {
            spanColor = '#0f172a';
            diffTextColor = '#0f172a';
          } else if (severityLevel === 3) {
            spanColor = '#334155';
            diffTextColor = '#334155';
          } else if (severityLevel === 2) {
            spanColor = '#64748b';
            diffTextColor = '#64748b';
          } else {
            spanColor = '#94a3b8';
            diffTextColor = '#94a3b8';
          }
        } else {
          if (gapType === 'neutral') {
            spanColor = '#cbd5e1';
            diffTextColor = '#64748b';
            gapLabel = 'Neutral Parity';
          } else if (gapType === 'adverse') {
            if (severityLevel === 4) {
              spanColor = '#dc2626';
              diffTextColor = '#991b1b';
              gapLabel = 'Severe Deficit / High Vulnerability';
            } else if (severityLevel === 3) {
              spanColor = '#ef4444';
              diffTextColor = '#b91c1c';
              gapLabel = 'Substantial Deficit';
            } else if (severityLevel === 2) {
              spanColor = '#f87171';
              diffTextColor = '#dc2626';
              gapLabel = 'Moderate Deficit';
            } else {
              spanColor = '#fca5a5';
              diffTextColor = '#e11d48';
              gapLabel = 'Mild Deficit';
            }
          } else {
            if (severityLevel === 4) {
              spanColor = '#059669';
              diffTextColor = '#065f46';
              gapLabel = 'High Advantage vs National';
            } else if (severityLevel === 3) {
              spanColor = '#10b981';
              diffTextColor = '#047857';
              gapLabel = 'Substantial Advantage';
            } else if (severityLevel === 2) {
              spanColor = '#34d399';
              diffTextColor = '#059669';
              gapLabel = 'Moderate Advantage';
            } else {
              spanColor = '#86efac';
              diffTextColor = '#16a34a';
              gapLabel = 'Mild Advantage';
            }
          }
        }

        let tierClass = 'rank-tier-mod';
        let tierLabel = 'Moderate';
        if (d.directionality === 'neutral') {
          tierClass = 'rank-tier-neutral';
          tierLabel = 'Demographic Distribution';
        } else if (d.directionality === 'lower_is_better') {
          if (cRank >= 35) { tierClass = 'rank-tier-high'; tierLabel = 'High Vulnerability'; }
          else if (cRank <= 15) { tierClass = 'rank-tier-low'; tierLabel = 'Lower Risk'; }
        } else {
          if (cRank >= 35) { tierClass = 'rank-tier-high'; tierLabel = 'High Deficit'; }
          else if (cRank <= 15) { tierClass = 'rank-tier-low'; tierLabel = 'Advantaged'; }
        }

        const diffDisplay = d.directionality === 'neutral' 
          ? `<span style="color: ${diffTextColor}; font-weight: 600;">${diffSign}${diff}${d.unit}</span>`
          : `<span style="color: ${diffTextColor}; font-weight: 700;">${diffSign}${diff}${d.unit}</span>`;

        if (currentGesiPlotType === 'paired_bar') {
          html += `
            <div class="indicator-plot-row ${selectedClass}" onclick="selectIndicatorRow('${d.id}')" title="Click to inspect KNBS indicator profile">
              <div class="row-label-col">
                <div class="row-label-domain">${d.domain_label}</div>
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px;">
                  <span>${d.name}</span>
                  <span class="enso-tooltip-wrap" onclick="event.stopPropagation();">
                    <span class="enso-tooltip-icon" tabindex="0" title="${d.climate_relevance ? d.climate_relevance.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') : 'Climate transmission mechanism'}">ℹ</span>
                    <span class="enso-tooltip-bubble"><strong>Why this matters:</strong> ${d.climate_relevance ? d.climate_relevance.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') : d.directionality_rationale}</span>
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-gauge-col">
                <div class="paired-bar-container">
                  <div class="paired-bar-row" style="width: ${countyPos}%; background: ${countyDotColor};" title="${activeCounty}: ${cVal}${d.unit}"></div>
                  <div class="paired-bar-row" style="width: ${natPos}%; background: #94a3b8;" title="National Avg: ${d.natAvg}${d.unit}"></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-values-col">
                <div class="val-county" style="font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">${cVal}${d.unit}</div>
                <div class="val-nat" style="color: #64748b; font-size: 0.72rem;">Nat: ${d.natAvg}${d.unit} (${diffDisplay})</div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-rank-col">
                <span class="rank-badge ${tierClass}" title="${tierLabel}">Rank #${cRank}/47</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          `;
        } else if (currentGesiPlotType === 'rank_bar') {
          const rankPct = Math.min(100, Math.max(2, (cRank / 47.0) * 100));
          html += `
            <div class="indicator-plot-row ${selectedClass}" onclick="selectIndicatorRow('${d.id}')" title="Click to inspect KNBS indicator profile">
              <div class="row-label-col">
                <div class="row-label-domain">${d.domain_label}</div>
                <div>${d.name}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-gauge-col">
                <div class="gauge-track">
                  <div style="height:100%; width:${rankPct}%; background:${countyDotColor}; border-radius:3px;"></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-values-col">
                <div class="val-county" style="font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">${cVal}${d.unit}</div>
                <div class="val-nat" style="color: #64748b; font-size: 0.72rem;">Nat: ${d.natAvg}${d.unit} (${diffDisplay})</div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-rank-col">
                <span class="rank-badge ${tierClass}" title="${tierLabel}">Rank #${cRank}/47</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          `;
        } else {
          // Default: Dumbbell / Gap Plot
          html += `
            <div class="indicator-plot-row ${selectedClass}" onclick="selectIndicatorRow('${d.id}')" title="Click to inspect KNBS indicator profile">
              <div class="row-label-col">
                <div class="row-label-domain">${d.domain_label}</div>
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px;">
                  <span>${d.name}</span>
                  <span class="enso-tooltip-wrap" onclick="event.stopPropagation();">
                    <span class="enso-tooltip-icon" tabindex="0" title="${d.climate_relevance ? d.climate_relevance.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') : 'Climate transmission mechanism'}">ℹ</span>
                    <span class="enso-tooltip-bubble"><strong>Why this matters:</strong> ${d.climate_relevance ? d.climate_relevance.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') : d.directionality_rationale}</span>
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-gauge-col">
                <div class="gauge-track">
                  <div class="gauge-span-bar" style="left: ${minPos}%; width: ${spanWidth}%; background: ${spanColor};" title="${gapLabel}: ${diffSign}${diff}${d.unit}"></div>
                  <div class="gauge-marker-nat" style="left: ${natPos}%;" title="Kenya National Benchmark: ${d.natAvg}${d.unit}"></div>
                  <div class="gauge-marker-county" style="left: ${countyPos}%; background: ${countyDotColor};" title="${activeCounty} County: ${cVal}${d.unit}"></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-values-col">
                <div class="val-county" style="font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;">${cVal}${d.unit}</div>
                <div class="val-nat" style="color: #64748b; font-size: 0.72rem;">Nat: ${d.natAvg}${d.unit} (${diffDisplay})</div>
              </div>
              <div class="row-rank-col">
                <span class="rank-badge ${tierClass}" title="${tierLabel}">Rank #${cRank}/47</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          `;
        }
      });

      container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function renderMultiIndicatorTable() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('gesi-table-tbody');
      if (!tbody) return;
      const indicators = getActiveIndicatorList();

      let html = '';
      indicators.forEach(d => {
        const hasVal = d.countyVal != null && !Number.isNaN(d.countyVal);
        const cVal = hasVal ? d.countyVal : null;
        const cRank = (hasVal && d.countyRank != null) ? d.countyRank : null;

        let dirBadge = '';
        if (d.directionality === 'neutral') {
          dirBadge = `<span style="display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;background:#f1f5f9;color:#475569;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:700;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;">Neutral (Demographic)</span>`;
        } else if (d.directionality === 'lower_is_better') {
          dirBadge = `<span style="display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;background:#fef2f2;color:#991b1b;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:700;border:1px solid #fecaca;">Lower is Desirable</span>`;
        } else {
          dirBadge = `<span style="display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;background:#ecfdf5;color:#065f46;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:700;border:1px solid #a7f3d0;">Higher is Desirable</span>`;
        }

        const isSelected = d.id === currentSelectedIndicatorId;
        const rowStyle = isSelected ? 'background: #e6f3f3; font-weight: 700;' : '';

        if (!hasVal) {
          html += `
            <tr style="${rowStyle}; cursor: pointer;" onclick="selectIndicatorRow('${d.id}')">
              <td><span class="row-label-domain">${d.domain_label}</span></td>
              <td><strong>${d.name}</strong> <code style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#64748b;">${d.code || ''}</code></td>
              <td style="color: #94a3b8; font-style: italic;">Not available</td>
              <td style="color: #64748b;">${d.natAvg}${d.unit}</td>
              <td style="color: #94a3b8;">—</td>
              <td>${dirBadge}</td>
              <td style="color: #94a3b8;">—</td>
              <td><span class="rank-badge rank-tier-neutral" style="background:#f1f5f9; color:#64748b; border:1px solid #cbd5e1;">Unavailable</span></td>
            </tr>
          `;
          return;
        }

        const diff = Math.round((cVal - d.natAvg) * 10) / 10;
        const diffSign = diff > 0 ? '+' : '';

        let tier = 'Moderate Parity';
        let tierClass = 'rank-tier-mod';
        if (d.directionality === 'neutral') {
          tier = 'Demographic Context';
          tierClass = 'rank-tier-neutral';
        } else if (d.directionality === 'lower_is_better') {
          tier = cRank >= 35 ? 'High Vulnerability' : (cRank <= 15 ? 'Lower Risk' : 'Moderate');
          tierClass = cRank >= 35 ? 'rank-tier-high' : (cRank <= 15 ? 'rank-tier-low' : 'rank-tier-mod');
        } else {
          tier = cRank >= 35 ? 'High Deficit' : (cRank <= 15 ? 'High Advantage' : 'Moderate');
          tierClass = cRank >= 35 ? 'rank-tier-high' : (cRank <= 15 ? 'rank-tier-low' : 'rank-tier-mod');
        }

        let diffCol = `<span style="color:#64748b;font-weight:600;">${diffSign}${diff}${d.unit}</span>`;
        if (d.directionality !== 'neutral') {
          const isAdv = (d.directionality === 'lower_is_better' && diff > 0) || (d.directionality === 'higher_is_better' && diff < 0);
          diffCol = isAdv 
            ? `<span style="color:#b91c1c;font-weight:700;">${diffSign}${diff}${d.unit}</span>`
            : `<span style="color:#047857;font-weight:700;">${diffSign}${diff}${d.unit}</span>`;
        }

        html += `
          <tr style="${rowStyle}; cursor: pointer;" onclick="selectIndicatorRow('${d.id}')">
            <td><span class="row-label-domain">${d.domain_label}</span></td>
            <td><strong>${d.name}</strong> <code style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#64748b;">${d.code || ''}</code></td>
            <td style="color: #0284c7; font-weight: 700;">${cVal}${d.unit}</td>
            <td style="color: #64748b;">${d.natAvg}${d.unit}</td>
            <td>${diffCol}</td>
            <td>${dirBadge}</td>
            <td><strong>#${cRank}</strong> / 47</td>
            <td><span class="rank-badge ${tierClass}">${tier}</span></td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });

      tbody.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function toggleGesiView(mode) {
      currentGesiView = mode;
      const plotCanvas = document.getElementById('gesi-plot-canvas');
      const tableContainer = document.getElementById('gesi-table-container');
      const legendBar = document.getElementById('gesi-legend-bar');
      const plotBtn = document.getElementById('btn-view-plot-gesi');
      const tableBtn = document.getElementById('btn-view-table-gesi');

      if (mode === 'table') {
        plotCanvas.style.display = 'none';
        if (legendBar) legendBar.style.display = 'none';
        tableContainer.style.display = 'block';
        plotBtn.classList.remove('active');
        tableBtn.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        plotCanvas.style.display = 'flex';
        if (legendBar) legendBar.style.display = 'flex';
        tableContainer.style.display = 'none';
        plotBtn.classList.add('active');
        tableBtn.classList.remove('active');
      }
    }

    function changeGesiPlotType(type) {
      currentGesiPlotType = type;
      renderMultiIndicatorPlot();
    }

    function changeGesiPalette(palette) {
      currentGesiPalette = palette;
      renderMultiIndicatorPlot();
    }

    function changeGesiDensity(density) {
      currentGesiDensity = density;
      renderMultiIndicatorPlot();
    }

    window.buildGesiSvg = function() {
      const county = (typeof currentGesiCountyName !== 'undefined' && currentGesiCountyName) ? currentGesiCountyName : 'Marsabit';
      const indicators = getActiveIndicatorList();
      const W = 840, rowH = 42, H = 70 + indicators.length * rowH;
      
      let svgContent = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${W}" height="${H}" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" style="background:#ffffff;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;">`;
      svgContent += `<text x="20" y="28" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Socio-Economic &amp; Gender Vulnerability Profile — ${county} County</text>`;
      svgContent += `<text x="20" y="46" font-size="11" fill="#64748b">KNBS 2019 Census &amp; 2023 County Gender Data Sheets • Benchmark: 47 Counties</text>`;
      
      indicators.forEach((d, i) => {
        const y = 80 + i * rowH;
        const hasVal = d.countyVal != null && !Number.isNaN(d.countyVal);
        let maxScale = d.maxScale || 100;
        
        const natPos = Math.min(380, Math.max(10, (d.natAvg / maxScale) * 380));
        const natX = 270 + natPos;
        svgContent += `<text x="20" y="${y+4}" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1e293b">${d.name.slice(0, 34)}</text>`;
        svgContent += `<line x1="270" y1="${y}" x2="650" y2="${y}" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
        
        if (hasVal) {
          const countyPos = Math.min(380, Math.max(10, (d.countyVal / maxScale) * 380));
          const countyX = 270 + countyPos;
          svgContent += `<line x1="${Math.min(natX, countyX)}" y1="${y}" x2="${Math.max(natX, countyX)}" y2="${y}" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="4"/>`;
          svgContent += `<circle cx="${natX}" cy="${y}" r="5" fill="#475569"/>`;
          svgContent += `<circle cx="${countyX}" cy="${y}" r="6" fill="#0284c7"/>`;
          svgContent += `<text x="665" y="${y+4}" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">${d.countyVal}${d.unit}</text>`;
          svgContent += `<text x="740" y="${y+4}" font-size="11" fill="#64748b">#${d.countyRank || '—'}</text>`;
        } else {
          svgContent += `<circle cx="${natX}" cy="${y}" r="5" fill="#475569"/>`;
          svgContent += `<text x="665" y="${y+4}" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#94a3b8">Not available</text>`;
        }
      });
      svgContent += `</svg>`;
      return svgContent;
    };

    // --- REAL-TIME DATASET SEARCH & CATEGORY FILTERING ---
    let currentCategoryFilter = 'all';

    function handleDatasetSearch(query) {
      const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
      const clearBtn = document.getElementById('clearDatasetSearch');
      if (clearBtn) {
        clearBtn.style.display = q ? 'flex' : 'none';
      }
      applyDatasetFilters();
    }

    function clearDatasetSearch() {
      const searchInput = document.getElementById('datasetSearchInput');
      if (searchInput) {
        searchInput.value = '';
        searchInput.focus();
      }
      const clearBtn = document.getElementById('clearDatasetSearch');
      if (clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
      applyDatasetFilters();
    }

    function filterDatasetCategory(category) {
      currentCategoryFilter = category || 'all';
      const select = document.getElementById('datasetCategorySelect');
      if (select && select.value !== currentCategoryFilter) {
        select.value = currentCategoryFilter;
      }
      applyDatasetFilters();
    }

    function applyDatasetFilters() {
      const searchInput = document.getElementById('datasetSearchInput');
      const query = searchInput ? searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.dataset-card');
      let visibleCount = 0;

      cards.forEach(card => {
        const category = card.getAttribute('data-category') || '';
        const searchTerms = (card.getAttribute('data-search') || '') + ' ' + card.innerText.toLowerCase();
        
        const matchesCategory = (currentCategoryFilter === 'all') || (category === currentCategoryFilter);
        const matchesQuery = !query || searchTerms.includes(query);

        if (matchesCategory && matchesQuery) {
          card.style.display = '';
          visibleCount++;
        } else {
          card.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });

      // Update counter
      const countEl = document.getElementById('visibleDatasetCount');
      if (countEl) countEl.innerText = visibleCount;

      // Handle empty state
      const grid = document.getElementById('datasetCatalogGrid');
      let noResults = document.getElementById('noDatasetsMatch');

      if (visibleCount === 0) {
        if (!noResults && grid) {
          noResults = document.createElement('div');
          noResults.id = 'noDatasetsMatch';
          noResults.className = 'no-results-box';
          noResults.innerHTML = `
            <h4>No Datasets Found Matching Your Search</h4>
            <p style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
              No records matched the filter query "${query}". Try searching by variable (e.g. NDVI, rainfall, prices) or provider.
            </p>
            <button class="btn-dataset-jump" onclick="resetAllDatasetFilters()">Reset Search &amp; Category Filters</button>
          `;
          grid.appendChild(noResults);
        }
      } else if (noResults) {
        noResults.remove();
      }
    }

    function resetAllDatasetFilters() {
      clearDatasetSearch();
      const select = document.getElementById('datasetCategorySelect');
      if (select) select.value = 'all';
      filterDatasetCategory('all');
    }

    function switchScienceTrack(track) {
      const layBtn = document.getElementById('btn-track-lay');
      const techBtn = document.getElementById('btn-track-tech');
      const layBlocks = document.querySelectorAll('.track-content-lay');
      const techBlocks = document.querySelectorAll('.track-content-tech');

      if (track === 'tech') {
        if (techBtn) techBtn.classList.add('active');
        if (layBtn) layBtn.classList.remove('active');
        layBlocks.forEach(b => b.style.display = 'none');
        techBlocks.forEach(b => b.style.display = 'block');
      } else {
        if (layBtn) layBtn.classList.add('active');
        if (techBtn) techBtn.classList.remove('active');
        layBlocks.forEach(b => b.style.display = 'block');
        techBlocks.forEach(b => b.style.display = 'none');
      }
    }

    // ---- VERSION HISTORY & CHANGELOG MODAL CONTROLLER (KE-47, Decision D38) ----
    async function getChangelogReleaseMeta() {
      if (window.__releaseMeta && Array.isArray(window.__releaseMeta.availableVersions)) {
        return window.__releaseMeta;
      }
      try {
        const res = await fetch("../../data/KE-enso-explorer/release.json");
        if (res.ok) {
          window.__releaseMeta = await res.json();
          return window.__releaseMeta;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      try {
        const res = await fetch("/data/KE-enso-explorer/release.json");
        if (res.ok) {
          window.__releaseMeta = await res.json();
          return window.__releaseMeta;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      return null;
    }

    window.openChangelogModal = async function(targetVersionId) {
      const backdrop = document.getElementById("changelogModalBackdrop");
      const modal = document.getElementById("changelogModal");
      if (!backdrop || !modal) return;

      backdrop.style.display = "block";
      modal.style.display = "flex";
      document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

      const meta = await getChangelogReleaseMeta();
      if (!meta || !Array.isArray(meta.availableVersions)) {
        const body = document.getElementById("clModalBody");
        if (body) {
          body.innerHTML = `
            <div style="padding: 2rem; text-align: center; color: #991b1b;">
              <strong>Unable to load release metadata.</strong>
              <p style="font-size: 0.82rem; margin-top: 0.5rem; color: #64748b;">Please verify connectivity to <code>data/KE-enso-explorer/release.json</code>.</p>
            </div>
          `;
        }
        return;
      }

      const versions = meta.availableVersions;
      const initialVer = versions.find(v => v.id === targetVersionId) || versions.find(v => v.status === "active") || versions[0];

      window.renderChangelogTabs(versions, initialVer.id);
      window.renderChangelogVersion(initialVer.id);
    };

    window.closeChangelogModal = function() {
      const backdrop = document.getElementById("changelogModalBackdrop");
      const modal = document.getElementById("changelogModal");
      if (backdrop) backdrop.style.display = "none";
      if (modal) modal.style.display = "none";
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };

    window.renderChangelogTabs = function(versions, activeId) {
      const tabsBar = document.getElementById("clVersionTabs");
      if (!tabsBar || !Array.isArray(versions)) return;

      tabsBar.innerHTML = versions.map(v => {
        const isSelected = v.id === activeId;
        const statusBadge = v.status === "active"
          ? `<span style="background: #10b981; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.60rem; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase;">Current</span>`
          : `<span style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 0.60rem; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 600;">${v.version}</span>`;
        return `
          <button type="button" class="cl-tab-btn ${isSelected ? "is-active" : ""}" onclick="window.renderChangelogVersion('${v.id}')">
            <span>${v.label.split('(')[0].trim()}</span>
            ${statusBadge}
          </button>
        `;
      }).join("");
    };

    window.renderChangelogVersion = function(versionId) {
      const meta = window.__releaseMeta;
      if (!meta || !Array.isArray(meta.availableVersions)) return;
      const v = meta.availableVersions.find(item => item.id === versionId) || meta.availableVersions[0];

      // Update tab selection state
      const tabsBar = document.getElementById("clVersionTabs");
      if (tabsBar) {
        const buttons = tabsBar.querySelectorAll(".cl-tab-btn");
        meta.availableVersions.forEach((item, idx) => {
          if (buttons[idx]) {
            if (item.id === v.id) buttons[idx].classList.add("is-active");
            else buttons[idx].classList.remove("is-active");
          }
        });
      }

      const body = document.getElementById("clModalBody");
      if (!body) return;

      const isCurrentPage = v.status === "active";

      let out = "";

      // Version Overview Card
      out += `
        <div class="cl-version-meta-box">
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
            <div style="flex: 1 1 320px;">
              <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">
                <span style="font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a;">${v.label}</span>
                ${v.status === 'active' 
                  ? `<span style="background: #ecfdf5; color: #065f46; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px; text-transform: uppercase;">Active Release</span>`
                  : `<span style="background: #fffbeb; color: #92400e; border: 1px solid #fde68a; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px; text-transform: uppercase;">Archived Milestone</span>`
                }
                ${v.build ? `<span style="font-family: var(--font-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.70rem; color: #64748b; background: #f1f5f9; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600;">build ${v.build}</span>` : ""}
              </div>
              <div style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">
                <strong>Release Date:</strong> ${v.date || "N/A"} &bull; 
                <strong>Data Vintage:</strong> ${meta.dataVintage || "2026-09"}
              </div>
              <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 0.84rem; color: #334155; line-height: 1.5;">${v.description || ""}</p>
            </div>
            <div style="flex-shrink: 0;">
              ${!isCurrentPage ? `
                <a href="${v.url}" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; background: #0284c7; color: #ffffff; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(2,132,199,0.3);">
                  <span>Switch to this Edition &rarr;</span>
                </a>
              ` : `
                <span style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; background: #ecfdf5; color: #065f46; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0;">
                  <span>✓ Currently Active Edition</span>
                </span>
              `}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      // Highlights
      if (Array.isArray(v.highlights) && v.highlights.length > 0) {
        out += `
          <div class="cl-category-card" style="border-left: 4px solid #0284c7; background: #f0f9ff;">
            <div class="cl-category-header" style="color: #0369a1; border-bottom-color: #e0f2fe;">
              <span style="font-size: 1rem;">🌟</span>
              <span>Milestone Highlights</span>
            </div>
            <ul class="cl-item-list">
              ${v.highlights.map(h => `<li style="color: #0c4a6e;">${h}</li>`).join("")}
            </ul>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      // Categorized changes
      if (Array.isArray(v.categories) && v.categories.length > 0) {
        v.categories.forEach(cat => {
          out += `
            <div class="cl-category-card">
              <div class="cl-category-header">
                <span style="font-size: 1rem;">${cat.icon || "📌"}</span>
                <span>${cat.title}</span>
              </div>
              <ul class="cl-item-list">
                ${cat.items.map(item => `<li>${item}</li>`).join("")}
              </ul>
            </div>
          `;
        });
      }

      // Associated decisions
      if (Array.isArray(v.decisions) && v.decisions.length > 0) {
        out += `
          <div class="cl-category-card" style="background: #fafafa;">
            <div class="cl-category-header" style="font-size: 0.78rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #64748b;">
              <span>📋 Ratified Decisions from DECISIONS.md</span>
            </div>
            <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; margin-top: 0.25rem;">
              ${v.decisions.map(d => `<span class="cl-decision-pill">${d}</span>`).join("")}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      body.innerHTML = out;
    };

    // Keyboard and Hash listeners for Changelog
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        const modal = document.getElementById("changelogModal");
        if (modal && modal.style.display !== "none") {
          window.closeChangelogModal();
        }
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('hashchange', function() {
      if (window.location.hash === '#changelog') {
        window.openChangelogModal();
      }
    });

    if (window.location.hash === '#changelog' || window.location.search.includes('changelog=true')) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (typeof window.openChangelogModal === 'function') {
          window.openChangelogModal();
        }
      }, 350);
    }

    /* Executive County Brief Global Navigation & Print Handlers (KE-48 / Decision D55) */
    window.jumpToExecutiveBrief = function() {
      if (typeof window.switchTab === 'function') {
        window.switchTab('tab-start');
      }
      setTimeout(() => {
        const el = document.getElementById('section-executive-brief');
        if (el) {
          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
          el.classList.add('brief-pulse-highlight');
          setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('brief-pulse-highlight'), 1800);
        }
      }, 50);
    };

    window.printExecutiveBrief = function() {
      document.body.classList.add('printing-executive-brief');
      window.print();
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.body.classList.remove('printing-executive-brief');
      }, 1000);
    };

    window.addEventListener('afterprint', function() {
      document.body.classList.remove('printing-executive-brief');
    });

    window.copyBriefProposalText = function(text) {
      const pText = text || document.getElementById('briefProposalText')?.innerText || "";
      if (!pText) return;
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(pText).then(() => {
          if (typeof window.showToast === 'function') {
            window.showToast("✓ Proposal rationale copied to clipboard!");
          } else {
            alert("✓ Proposal rationale copied to clipboard!");
          }
        }).catch(() => {
          fallbackCopyText(pText);
        });
      } else {
        fallbackCopyText(pText);
      }
    };

    function fallbackCopyText(txt) {
      const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
      ta.value = txt;
      ta.style.position = 'fixed';
      ta.style.opacity = '0';
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      try {
        document.execCommand('copy');
        if (typeof window.showToast === 'function') {
          window.showToast("✓ Proposal rationale copied to clipboard!");
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      document.body.removeChild(ta);
    }
  
</script>
```

```{ojs}
// ---- TAB 1 LIVE DATA BINDINGS (VoP, Demographics, Livestock, Crops, GESI) ----
dbVop = DuckDBClient.of({
  vop: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/exposure_vop.parquet")
})

vopCty = dbVop.query(`
  SELECT commodity, kind, vop_intld15
  FROM vop
  WHERE ${normExpr("county")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
  ORDER BY vop_intld15 DESC
`)

vopSummary = {
  const total = d3.sum(vopCty, d => d.vop_intld15) || 1;
  const livestock = d3.sum(vopCty.filter(d => d.kind === "Livestock"), d => d.vop_intld15) || 0;
  const crops = d3.sum(vopCty.filter(d => d.kind === "Crop"), d => d.vop_intld15) || 0;
  return {
    total,
    livestock,
    crops,
    pctLivestock: (livestock / total) * 100,
    pctCrops: (crops / total) * 100,
    topLivestock: vopCty.filter(d => d.kind === "Livestock").slice(0, 4),
    topCrops: vopCty.filter(d => d.kind === "Crop").slice(0, 4)
  };
}

countyCensus = {
  const rows = await dbExposure.query(`
    SELECT adm1_pcode,
           adm1_name,
           pop_total,
           land_area_km2,
           pop_density_km2,
           households
    FROM census_adm1
    WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
  `);
  return rows[0] || {
    adm1_pcode: "KE010",
    adm1_name: county,
    pop_total: 459785,
    land_area_km2: 70944.27,
    pop_density_km2: 6.48,
    households: 77495
  };
}

countyTotals = {
  const rows = await dbExposure.query(`
    SELECT adm1_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT adm2_name) AS n_subcounties,
           SUM(area_km2) AS total_area_km2,
           SUM(pop_total) AS total_pop,
           SUM(pop_total / NULLIF(pop_growth_county, 0)) AS total_pop_2019
    FROM exp_tot
    WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
    GROUP BY adm1_name
  `);
  return rows[0] || {
    n_subcounties: 4,
    total_area_km2: 76028,
    total_pop: 529309,
    total_pop_2019: 459785
  };
}

countySubcounties = {
  const rows = await dbExposure.query(`
    SELECT adm2_name AS subcounty,
           area_km2,
           pop_total,
           pop_total_grid,
           pop_scale_census,
           pop_growth_county,
           ROUND(pop_total / NULLIF(pop_growth_county, 0)) AS pop_2019,
           pop_source,
           pop_year,
           pop_method
    FROM exp_tot
    WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
    ORDER BY area_km2 DESC
  `);
  return rows || [];
}

countySubClim = {
  const rows = await dbExposure.query(`
    SELECT adm2_name AS subcounty,
           mam_mean_mm,
           ond_mean_mm,
           bimodal_total_mm,
           mam_pct,
           ond_pct,
           dominant_season
    FROM sub_clim
    WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
    ORDER BY bimodal_total_mm DESC
  `);
  return rows || [];
}

// Reactive watcher for Tab 1
// Reactive Bimodal Climatology (1991-2020 CHIRPS)
countyRainClim = {
  const rows = await dbChirps.query(`
    SELECT period, AVG(value_mean) AS clim_mm
    FROM chirps_county
    WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
      AND variable = 'PTOT' AND period IN ('OND', 'MAM') AND year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020
    GROUP BY period
  `);
  let mam = 0, ond = 0;
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (r.period === "MAM") mam = r.clim_mm;
    if (r.period === "OND") ond = r.clim_mm;
  }
  const total = (mam + ond) || 1;
  return {
    mam_mm: Math.round(mam),
    ond_mm: Math.round(ond),
    mam_pct: Math.round((mam / total) * 100),
    ond_pct: Math.round((ond / total) * 100),
    total_mm: Math.round(mam + ond)
  };
}

// Active Tab 1 Sync Node (Reactively updates DOM on county / data changes)
{
  [county, countyTotals, countyCensus, countySubcounties, countySubClim, vopSummary, liveCty, naprCty, gesiSeries, countyRainClim];

  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.document) {
    // 1. County text placeholders
    document.querySelectorAll(".county-name-txt").forEach(el => {
      el.textContent = county;
    });

    const legendCounty = document.getElementById("gesi-legend-county-label");
    if (legendCounty) legendCounty.textContent = `${county} County Value`;

    // 2. Baseline Metrics (% of national total)
    const elArea = document.getElementById("metric-land-area");
    const elPop = document.getElementById("metric-population");
    const elSubPop = document.getElementById("metric-sub-population");
    const elAsset = document.getElementById("metric-primary-asset");
    const elSubAsset = document.getElementById("metric-sub-asset");

    if (countyCensus && countyTotals) {
      if (elArea) elArea.textContent = `${Math.round(countyCensus.land_area_km2).toLocaleString()} km²`;
      if (elPop) elPop.textContent = `${Math.round(countyCensus.pop_total).toLocaleString()}`;
      if (elSubPop) elSubPop.textContent = `KNBS 2019 Census • ${countyTotals.n_subcounties} Constituencies`;

      const natAreaTotal = 580895.36; // Official KNBS 2019 Census national land area
      const natPopTotal = 47564296; // Official KNBS 2019 Census enumerated national population
      const pctArea = ((countyCensus.land_area_km2 / natAreaTotal) * 100).toFixed(1);
      const pctPop = ((countyCensus.pop_total / natPopTotal) * 100).toFixed(2);
      const elAreaPct = document.getElementById("metric-area-pct");
      const elPopPct = document.getElementById("metric-pop-pct");
      if (elAreaPct) elAreaPct.textContent = `${pctArea}% of Kenya`;
      if (elPopPct) elPopPct.textContent = `${pctPop}% of national total`;
    }

    // Sub-County Count Badge Sync
    const elSubCount = document.getElementById("subcounty-count-txt");
    if (elSubCount && countySubcounties) {
      elSubCount.textContent = countySubcounties.length;
    }

    const elRain = document.getElementById("metric-rainfall-season");
    const elSubRain = document.getElementById("metric-sub-rainfall");
    if (countyRainClim) {
      if (elRain) elRain.innerHTML = `MAM: ${countyRainClim.mam_pct}% &bull; OND: ${countyRainClim.ond_pct}%`;
      if (elSubRain) elSubRain.innerHTML = `MAM: ${countyRainClim.mam_mm} mm &bull; OND: ${countyRainClim.ond_mm} mm (1991–2020 Climatology)`;
    }

    if (vopSummary) {
      const isLive = vopSummary.pctLivestock >= 50;
      const dominantPct = isLive ? vopSummary.pctLivestock : vopSummary.pctCrops;
      if (elAsset) elAsset.textContent = `${isLive ? "Livestock" : "Crops"} (${dominantPct.toFixed(1)}%)`;
      if (elSubAsset) {
        const topItems = (isLive ? vopSummary.topLivestock : vopSummary.topCrops).map(d => d.commodity).join(", ");
        elSubAsset.textContent = isLive
          ? (topItems ? `${topItems} (excl. camels)` : "Pastoral herds (excl. camels)")
          : (topItems || "Cultivated crops");
      }
    }

    // 3. Section 1.1 (Official Administrative Baseline)
    const elLiveTitle = document.getElementById("statutory-live-title");
    if (elLiveTitle) elLiveTitle.textContent = `${county.toUpperCase()} LIVESTOCK POPULATION (KNBS OFFICIAL CENSUS)`;
    const elLiveGrid = document.getElementById("statutory-livestock-grid");
    if (elLiveGrid && liveCty) {
      const liveItems = [...new Set(liveCty.map(d => d.item))];
      const liveSummaries = liveItems.map(item => {
        const itemRows = liveCty.filter(d => d.item === item && d.val != null && d.val > 0);
        if (!itemRows.length) return null;
        const minVal = d3.min(itemRows, d => d.val);
        const maxVal = d3.max(itemRows, d => d.val);
        const latestYr = d3.max(itemRows, d => d.year);
        const latestRow = itemRows.find(d => d.year === latestYr);
        return { item, minVal, maxVal, latestVal: latestRow?.val, latestYr };
      }).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.latestVal - a.latestVal);

      if (liveSummaries.length > 0) {
        elLiveGrid.innerHTML = liveSummaries.slice(0, 6).map(d => {
          if (d.minVal === d.maxVal) {
            return `<div><strong>${d.item}:</strong> ${Math.round(d.latestVal).toLocaleString()} head <span style="font-size:0.75rem; color:#64748b;">(${d.latestYr})</span></div>`;
          }
          return `<div style="margin-bottom:0.25rem;">
            <strong>${d.item}:</strong> ${Math.round(d.latestVal).toLocaleString()} head
            <div style="font-size:0.74rem; color:#64748b;">Latest: ${d.latestYr}; 3-yr range: ${Math.round(d.minVal).toLocaleString()}&ndash;${Math.round(d.maxVal).toLocaleString()} head</div>
          </div>`;
        }).join("");
      } else {
        elLiveGrid.innerHTML = `<div style="grid-column: 1 / -1; color: #64748b; font-style: italic;">No livestock population survey recorded in NAPR for ${county}.</div>`;
      }
    }

    const elCropTitle = document.getElementById("statutory-crop-title");
    if (elCropTitle) elCropTitle.textContent = `${county.toUpperCase()} CROP PRODUCTION (KNBS OFFICIAL NAPR)`;
    const elCropList = document.getElementById("statutory-crop-list");
    if (elCropList && naprCty) {
      const cropItems = [...new Set(naprCty.map(d => d.item))];
      const cropSummaries = cropItems.map(item => {
        const itemRows = naprCty.filter(d => d.item === item && d.val != null && d.val > 0);
        if (!itemRows.length) return null;
        const minVal = d3.min(itemRows, d => d.val);
        const maxVal = d3.max(itemRows, d => d.val);
        const latestYr = d3.max(itemRows, d => d.year);
        const latestRow = itemRows.find(d => d.year === latestYr);
        return { item, minVal, maxVal, latestVal: latestRow?.val, latestYr };
      }).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.latestVal - a.latestVal);

      if (cropSummaries.length > 0) {
        elCropList.innerHTML = cropSummaries.map(d => {
          return `<div style="margin-bottom:0.35rem;">
            &bull; <strong>${d.item}:</strong> ${Math.round(d.latestVal).toLocaleString()} tonnes <span style="font-size:0.74rem; color:#64748b;">(Latest: ${d.latestYr}; 5-yr range: ${Math.round(d.minVal).toLocaleString()}&ndash;${Math.round(d.maxVal).toLocaleString()} tonnes)</span>
          </div>`;
        }).join("") + `<div style="margin-top:0.35rem; font-size:0.72rem; color:#64748b;"><em>Note: In Kenya, KNBS crop production is reported in Metric Tonnes (1 MT = 1 tonne).</em></div>`;
      } else {
        elCropList.innerHTML = `<div>&bull; <strong>Arid / Pastoral Agro-Zone:</strong> Minimal rainfed field cropping recorded in KNBS reports.</div>`;
      }
    }

    // 4. Section 1.2 (Figure 1.2: Modeled VoP handled by dedicated reactive block below)

    // 5. Section 1.3 (Figure 1.3: GESI Multi-Indicator Plot)
    if (typeof window.updateGesiWithLiveSeries === "function" && gesiSeries) {
      window.updateGesiWithLiveSeries(county, gesiSeries);
    }
  }

  return html`<div class="tab1-active-sync" style="display:none" data-county="${county}"></div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// =============================================================================
// TABLE 1.1: SUB-COUNTY ADMINISTRATIVE & CLIMATOLOGICAL BASELINE
// =============================================================================
viewof subView = Inputs.radio(["Table", "Plot"], {
  label: "View:",
  value: "Table"
})

viewof subPlotVar = Inputs.select([
  "2026 Projected Pop",
  "2019 Census Pop",
  "Land Area (km²)",
  "Population Density",
  "MAM Rainfall (mm)",
  "OND Rainfall (mm)"
], {
  label: "Indicator:",
  value: "2026 Projected Pop"
})

subcountyCombinedData = {
  const ctyPopTot2026 = countyTotals?.total_pop || 1;
  const ctyPopTot2019 = countyCensus?.pop_total || (countyTotals?.total_pop_2019 || 1);
  const ctyAreaTot = countyTotals?.total_area_km2 || 1;

  const scMap = new Map();
  (countySubcounties || []).forEach(sc => {
    const pop2019 = sc.pop_2019 || Math.round(sc.pop_total / (sc.pop_growth_county || 1));
    scMap.set(sc.subcounty, {
      subcounty: sc.subcounty,
      area_km2: sc.area_km2,
      area_pct: (sc.area_km2 / ctyAreaTot) * 100,
      pop_2019: pop2019,
      pop_2019_pct: (pop2019 / ctyPopTot2019) * 100,
      pop_total: sc.pop_total,
      pop_pct: (sc.pop_total / ctyPopTot2026) * 100,
      density: Math.round(pop2019 / Math.max(1, sc.area_km2)),
      proj_2026: Math.round(sc.pop_total),
      mam_mean_mm: null,
      ond_mean_mm: null,
      bimodal_total_mm: null,
      mam_pct: null,
      ond_pct: null,
      dominant_season: "N/A"
    });
  });

  (countySubClim || []).forEach(cl => {
    const existing = scMap.get(cl.subcounty) || {
      subcounty: cl.subcounty,
      area_km2: 0,
      area_pct: 0,
      pop_2019: 0,
      pop_2019_pct: 0,
      pop_total: 0,
      pop_pct: 0,
      density: 0,
      proj_2026: 0
    };
    existing.mam_mean_mm = cl.mam_mean_mm;
    existing.ond_mean_mm = cl.ond_mean_mm;
    existing.bimodal_total_mm = cl.bimodal_total_mm;
    existing.mam_pct = cl.mam_pct;
    existing.ond_pct = cl.ond_pct;
    existing.dominant_season = cl.dominant_season;
    scMap.set(cl.subcounty, existing);
  });

  return Array.from(scMap.values()).sort((a, b) => (b.pop_total || 0) - (a.pop_total || 0));
}

// Mount Controls for Table 1.1 into #subControlsHost

// Render Table 1.1 into #subcountyContentHost and mount plotFooter into #table11FooterHost
{
  [county, subcountyCombinedData, subView, subPlotVar];
  const host = document.getElementById("subcountyContentHost");
  const countEl = document.getElementById("subcounty-count-txt");
  if (countEl) countEl.textContent = subcountyCombinedData.length;

  if (host && subcountyCombinedData && subcountyCombinedData.length > 0) {
    if (subView === "Table") {
      let tblHtml = `
        <div style="overflow-x: auto;">
          <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:0.8rem; text-align:left;">
            <thead>
              <tr style="border-bottom:1.5px solid #cbd5e1; color:#475569; background:#f1f5f9;">
                <th style="padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px 0 0 4px;">Constituency (IEBC)</th>
                <th style="padding:7px 10px; text-align:right;">Land Area</th>
                <th style="padding:7px 10px; text-align:right;">% Area</th>
                <th style="padding:7px 10px; text-align:right;">2019 Census Pop*</th>
                <th style="padding:7px 10px; text-align:right;">2026 Proj Pop</th>
                <th style="padding:7px 10px; text-align:right;">% Pop</th>
                <th style="padding:7px 10px; text-align:right;">Density</th>
                <th style="padding:7px 10px; text-align:right;">MAM Rain (mm)</th>
                <th style="padding:7px 10px; text-align:right;">OND Rain (mm)</th>
                <th style="padding:7px 10px; text-align:center; border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;">Dominant Season</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
      `;
      subcountyCombinedData.forEach((sc, i) => {
        const bg = i % 2 === 0 ? "#ffffff" : "#f8fafc";
        const dom = sc.dominant_season || 'Bimodal';
        const domBadge = dom.includes('Equimodal')
          ? 'background:#f1f5f9; color:#334155; border:1px solid #cbd5e1;'
          : dom.includes('MAM')
          ? 'background:#e0f2fe; color:#0369a1; border:1px solid #bae6fd;'
          : 'background:#ffedd5; color:#c2410c; border:1px solid #fed7aa;';
        tblHtml += `
          <tr style="background:${bg}; border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;">
            <td style="padding:6px 10px; font-weight:700; color:#0f172a;">${sc.subcounty}</td>
            <td style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:right;">${Math.round(sc.area_km2).toLocaleString()} km²</td>
            <td style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:right; color:#0284c7; font-weight:600;">${sc.area_pct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
            <td style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:right;">${Math.round(sc.pop_2019).toLocaleString()}</td>
            <td style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:right; font-weight:600; color:#0369a1;">${Math.round(sc.pop_total).toLocaleString()}</td>
            <td style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:right; color:#0284c7; font-weight:600;">${sc.pop_pct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
            <td style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:right; color:#64748b;">${sc.density} / km²</td>
            <td style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:right; color:#0284c7; font-weight:600;">${sc.mam_mean_mm != null ? Math.round(sc.mam_mean_mm) + ' mm' : '—'}</td>
            <td style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:right; color:#ea580c; font-weight:600;">${sc.ond_mean_mm != null ? Math.round(sc.ond_mean_mm) + ' mm' : '—'}</td>
            <td style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:center;"><span style="display:inline-block; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:3px; font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:700; ${domBadge}">${dom}</span></td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });
      tblHtml += `
            </tbody>
          </table>
          <div style="font-size:0.75rem; color:#64748b; margin-top:0.5rem; line-height:1.4;">
            <em>*<b>Administrative Boundary &amp; Demographic Footnote:</b> Sub-county units represent Kenya's 290 official IEBC parliamentary constituencies (COD-AB adm2 boundaries). This electoral universe differs from KNBS's 345 administrative sub-counties (e.g. Marsabit comprises 4 electoral constituencies — Laisamis, Moyale, North Horr, and Saku — versus 7 administrative sub-counties). Population headcounts represent official KNBS county totals (2019 Census enumerated headcount and 2026 official projection), spatially distributed across constituencies using WorldPop 100 m constrained settlement shares. Within-county population shares are held fixed at the 2020 distribution. Climatology: CHIRPS v3 (1991–2020) 30-year WMO baseline. <b>Dominant Season:</b> Classified as <b>Bimodal (Equimodal)</b> when Long Rains (MAM) and Short Rains (OND) accumulations differ by &lt;25 mm or each season accounts for 45%–55% of total bimodal rainfall (e.g. Saku in Marsabit: 290 mm MAM vs. 279 mm OND, 51% vs. 49%); <b>MAM (Long Rains)</b> when MAM &gt; 55% (diff &ge; 25 mm); and <b>OND (Short Rains)</b> when OND &gt; 55% (diff &ge; 25 mm).</em>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      host.innerHTML = tblHtml;
    } else {
      let valAccessor, valLabel, valFmt, fillColor;
      if (subPlotVar === "Land Area (km²)") {
        valAccessor = d => d.area_km2;
        valLabel = "Land Area (km²)";
        valFmt = d => `${Math.round(d).toLocaleString()} km²`;
        fillColor = "#0284c7";
      } else if (subPlotVar === "Population Density") {
        valAccessor = d => d.density;
        valLabel = "Population Density (persons / km²)";
        valFmt = d => `${d} / km²`;
        fillColor = "#0d9488";
      } else if (subPlotVar === "2019 Census Pop") {
        valAccessor = d => d.pop_2019;
        valLabel = "2019 Census Population (Distributed Headcount)";
        valFmt = d => Math.round(d).toLocaleString();
        fillColor = "#0284c7";
      } else if (subPlotVar === "MAM Rainfall (mm)") {
        valAccessor = d => d.mam_mean_mm || 0;
        valLabel = "Long Rains (MAM) 1991–2020 Mean (mm)";
        valFmt = d => `${Math.round(d)} mm`;
        fillColor = "#0284c7";
      } else if (subPlotVar === "OND Rainfall (mm)") {
        valAccessor = d => d.ond_mean_mm || 0;
        valLabel = "Short Rains (OND) 1991–2020 Mean (mm)";
        valFmt = d => `${Math.round(d)} mm`;
        fillColor = "#ea580c";
      } else {
        valAccessor = d => d.pop_total;
        valLabel = "2026 Projected Population (KNBS / WorldPop 100 m)";
        valFmt = d => Math.round(d).toLocaleString();
        fillColor = "#0284c7";
      }

      const sortedData = [...subcountyCombinedData].sort((a, b) => valAccessor(b) - valAccessor(a));
      const plotHeight = Math.max(160, 40 + sortedData.length * 36);

      const p = Plot.plot({
        height: plotHeight,
        marginLeft: 120,
        marginRight: 90,
        marginTop: 10,
        marginBottom: 35,
        x: { label: valLabel, grid: true },
        y: { label: null, domain: sortedData.map(d => d.subcounty) },
        marks: [
          Plot.barX(sortedData, {
            y: "subcounty",
            x: valAccessor,
            fill: fillColor,
            inset: 1.5,
            tip: { format: { y: true, x: valFmt } }
          }),
          Plot.text(sortedData, {
            y: "subcounty",
            x: valAccessor,
            text: d => valFmt(valAccessor(d)),
            dx: 6,
            textAnchor: "start",
            fontSize: 10,
            fontWeight: 700,
            fill: "#334155"
          })
        ]
      });
      host.replaceChildren(p);
    }
  }

  const footerHost = document.getElementById("table11FooterHost");
  if (footerHost) {
    const tableFooter = plotFooter(
      `Sub-county administrative breakdown and seasonal climatology in ${county} (IEBC COD-AB, KNBS 2019 Census & CHIRPS v3).`,
      host,
      {
        fig: "1.1",
        filename: `${county}_subcounty_baseline_table11`,
        data: subcountyCombinedData,
        about: `Official sub-county administrative boundaries from IEBC (290 parliamentary constituencies, COD-AB adm2), 2019 population census headcounts and 2026 projections from KNBS distributed via WorldPop 100 m constrained settlement shares, and 30-year rainfall climatology (1991–2020) from CHIRPS v3 satellite-gauge blending at 0.05° resolution. Within-county population shares are anchored to the 2020 distribution.`,
        meta: {
          County: county,
          "Administrative authority": "IEBC / KNBS 2019 Census",
          "Climatology baseline": "CHIRPS v3 (1991–2020)",
          "Population Denominators": "KNBS 2019 Census & 2026 Projections (WorldPop 100 m share)"
        },
        showTable: false
      }
    );
    footerHost.replaceChildren(tableFooter);
  }
}

            tip: {
              format: {
                y: true,
                x: v => `$${v.toFixed(2)}M (${((v * 1e6 / totalVoP) * 100).toFixed(1)}% of total VoP)`
              }
            }
          }),
          Plot.text(filtered, {
            y: "commodity",
            x: d => d.vop_intld15 / 1e6,
            text: d => `$${(d.vop_intld15 / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M (${((d.vop_intld15 / totalVoP) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`,
            dx: 6,
            textAnchor: "start",
            fontSize: 9.5,
            fontWeight: 700,
            fill: "#334155"
          })
        ]
      });

      const macroBar = html`
        <div style="background: #fffbeb; border: 1px solid #fde68a; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
          <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:0.86rem; font-weight:700;">
            <span>Pastoralist Livestock (Cattle, Goats, Sheep, Poultry &bull; Excludes Camels)</span>
            <span style="color: #0284c7;">${vopSummary.pctLivestock.toFixed(1)}% (USD ${(vopSummary.livestock / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M, 2021 nominal)</span>
          </div>
          <div style="height:14px; background:#e2e8f0; border-radius:7px; overflow:hidden; margin: 5px 0 8px;">
            <div id="vop-bar-livestock" style="width:${vopSummary.pctLivestock.toFixed(1)}%; height:100%; background:#0284c7; transition: width 0.3s ease;"></div>
          </div>
          <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:0.86rem; font-weight:700;">
            <span>Cultivated Crops (Maize, Sorghum, Pulses)</span>
            <span style="color: #b45309;">${vopSummary.pctCrops.toFixed(1)}% (USD ${(vopSummary.crops / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M, 2021 nominal)</span>
          </div>
          <div style="height:14px; background:#e2e8f0; border-radius:7px; overflow:hidden; margin-top:5px;">
            <div id="vop-bar-crop" style="width:${vopSummary.pctCrops.toFixed(1)}%; height:100%; background:#b45309; transition: width 0.3s ease;"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      host.replaceChildren(macroBar, rankedPlot);
    } else {
      // Sub-county map blocked state
      const blockedHtml = `
        <div class="enso-empty-state" style="padding: 1.75rem 1.25rem; text-align: center; background: #f8fafc; border: 1.5px dashed #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; margin: 0.5rem 0;">
          <div style="font-size: 1.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">🔒</div>
          <h4 style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; margin: 0 0 0.4rem;">
            Sub-County Spatial Allocation Pending Ingestion of GAUL Level 2 Zonal Summaries
          </h4>
          <p style="font-size: 0.84rem; color: #475569; max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto 0.75rem; line-height: 1.45;">
            <strong>Under Project Rule D1 (No hallucination / no inferred fiction)</strong>, sub-county commodity totals cannot be mathematically apportioned from county totals without genuine 1 km raster zonal statistics.
          </p>
          <div style="background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: left; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #334155; line-height: 1.45;">
            <div style="font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 0.25rem;">Data Dependency &amp; Spatial Nuance:</div>
            <div>&bull; <strong>Source Resolution:</strong> Modeled crop capital originates from <em>IFPRI MapSPAM 2020 v1r2</em> (1 km raster) and livestock capital from <em>FAO GLW4</em> (1 km raster), monetized at 2019&ndash;23 national farm-gate prices (crops: FAOSTAT implied prices with cited corrections; livestock: FAOSTAT producer prices).</div>
            <div>&bull; <strong>Pipeline Status:</strong> The current active layer (<code>exposure_vop.parquet</code>) contains audited county-level sums. Ingestion of GAUL Level 2 zonal statistics is tracked in pipeline milestone <code>hazards_prototype#31</code>.</div>
            <div>&bull; <strong>Agro-Pastoral Reality:</strong> In arid rangeland counties (such as ${county}), rainfed cropping is not evenly spread; it is clustered in highland or riverine micro-climates (e.g., Mount Marsabit / Saku and Moyale highlands in Marsabit; Loima Hills and Turkwel basin in Turkana). Faking uniform sub-county disaggregation would misrepresent pastoral climate vulnerability.</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      host.innerHTML = blockedHtml;
    }
  }

  const footerHost = document.getElementById("fig12FooterHost");
  if (footerHost) {
    const vopFooter = plotFooter(
      `Spatially modeled gross agricultural capital portfolio for ${county} in nominal 2021 USD (MapSPAM 2020 & GLW4).`,
      host,
      {
        fig: "1.2",
        filename: `${county}_exposure_vop_portfolio`,
        data: vopCty,
        about: `Modeled gross value of production in nominal 2021 USD (vop_nominal-usd21; undeflated). Crop distributions derived from IFPRI MapSPAM 2020 v1r2 (1 km raster) and livestock from FAO Gridded Livestock of the World (GLW4; 1 km raster; cattle, sheep, goats, pigs, and poultry; excludes camels). Values are modeled econometric estimates and should not be cited as official administrative census records. Prices: 2019-23 national farm-gate values; method in hazards_prototype docs/methods/nominal_price_method.md (revised 2026-10-06).`,
        meta: {
          Source: "IFPRI MapSPAM 2020 v1r2 / FAO GLW4 / FAOSTAT 2021",
          County: county,
          Currency: "Nominal 2021 USD"
        },
        showTable: false
      }
    );
    footerHost.replaceChildren(vopFooter);
  }
```
