```{ojs}
// ---- figure footer -------------------------------------------------------
// A figure's footer carries four things, per Pete's 2026-08-10 review (KE-13/14/15):
//   1. a SHORT, always-visible caption that leads with its Figure N.M number;
//   2. a foldable "About this plot" with the detailed methodology / how-to-read;
//   3. a foldable "Show data table" — the plotted rows in a neat, labelled table;
//   4. the image download button (PNG/SVG/CSV) + a metadata-stamped table CSV.
// plotFooter(caption, chart, opts) stays a one-liner at each call site. opts:
//   { filename, data, csvColumns, about, columns:[{key,label,fmt}], meta:{k:v} }.
// `about` and `columns`/`meta` are optional — a figure that omits them still
// renders (caption + auto-derived table). Detailed `about` text + friendly
// column labels are being filled in figure-by-figure; §4.3 is the exemplar.

// number formatter for the table view: thousands-separated, ≤2 dp, blanks kept blank.
plotTableFmt = (v) => {
  if (v == null || v === "") return "";
  if (typeof v === "number" && isFinite(v))
    return v.toLocaleString("en-US", {maximumFractionDigits: 2});
  return String(v);
}

// build the metadata header lines (# key: value) prepended to a table CSV.
plotTableMetaLines = (opts) => {
  const m = (opts && opts.meta) || {};
  const lines = [
    "# AAA Atlas — ENSO Explorer (Kenya)",
    `# Figure: ${(opts && opts.filename) || "figure"}`,
    `# Generated: ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`,
  ];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(m)) if (v != null) lines.push(`# ${k}: ${v}`);
  return lines;
}

// the plotted rows as a neat, labelled HTML table inside a <details>.
plotDataTable = (opts) => {
  const data = (opts && opts.data) || [];
  if (!Array.isArray(data) || !data.length) return "";
  const cols = (opts && opts.columns) ||
    Object.keys(data[0]).filter((k) => !k.startsWith("_"))
      .map((k) => ({key: k, label: k}));
  const table = html`<table class="plot-data-table">
    <thead><tr>${cols.map((c) => html`<th>${c.label}</th>`)}</tr></thead>
    <tbody>${data.map((row) => html`<tr>${cols.map((c) =>
      html`<td>${(c.fmt || plotTableFmt)(row[c.key], row)}</td>`)}</tr>`)}</tbody>
  </table>`;
  const onDownload = () => {
    const header = cols.map((c) => c.label).join(",");
    const esc = (v) => {
      const s = v == null ? "" : String(v);
      return /[",\n\r]/.test(s) ? '"' + s.split('"').join('""') + '"' : s;
    };
    const body = data.map((row) => cols.map((c) => esc(
      (c.fmt || plotTableFmt)(row[c.key], row))).join(",")).join("\r\n");
    const csv = plotTableMetaLines(opts).join("\r\n") + "\r\n\r\n" + header + "\r\n" + body;
    const blob = new Blob(["﻿", csv], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"});
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url; a.download = ((opts && opts.filename) || "table") + "_table.csv";
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };
  const dlBtn = html`<button class="plot-table-dl" type="button">⤓ Download table (CSV + metadata)</button>`;
  dlBtn.onclick = onDownload;
  return html`<details class="plot-caption-details">
    <summary>Show data table (${data.length} rows)</summary>
    <div class="plot-caption-body">${dlBtn}<div class="plot-data-table-wrap">${table}</div></div>
  </details>`;
}

plotFooter = (caption, chart, opts) => {
  const o = opts || {};
  const meta = {
    County: (typeof county !== "undefined" && county) ? county : "Marsabit",
    Season: (typeof season !== "undefined" && season) ? season : "OND",
    "Ocean driver": (typeof driverName !== "undefined" && driverName) ? driverName : "ENSO (RONI)",
    ...(o.meta || {})
  };
  const mergedOpts = { ...o, meta };
  const captionEl = caption && String(caption).trim()
    ? html`<div class="enso-figure-footer-note">
        <span style="font-weight: 600; color: #334155;">Figure Note:</span> ${String(caption).trim()}
      </div>`
    : html`<div class="enso-figure-footer-note"></div>`;
  const dlBtn = chartDownloadButton(chart, mergedOpts);
  const figTag = (o.fig ? `Figure ${o.fig}` : (o.filename || "Figure"));
  const fbBtn = html`<button type="button" class="btn-fig-feedback" onclick="window.openRcmrdFeedbackModal('${figTag}')" style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; background:none; border:none; color:#64748b; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; text-decoration:underline;" title="Share feedback on ${figTag}">💬 Feedback on ${figTag}</button>`;

  const aboutEl = mergedOpts.about && String(mergedOpts.about).trim()
    ? html`<details class="plot-caption-details" style="margin-top: 0.35rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #475569;">
        <summary style="cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; color: #0284c7; outline: none; list-style: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; user-select: none;">
          <span style="border-bottom: 1px dashed #0284c7;">ℹ️ About this plot (data &amp; methodology)</span>
        </summary>
        <div class="plot-caption-body" style="margin-top: 0.35rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.85rem; background: #f8fafc; border-left: 3px solid #0284c7; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; line-height: 1.55; color: #334155; font-size: 0.79rem;">
          ${md`${mergedOpts.about}`}
        </div>
      </details>`
    : "";

  return html`<div class="enso-figure-footer plot-footer">
    ${captionEl}
    <div class="enso-figure-footer-actions">${dlBtn} ${fbBtn}</div>
    ${aboutEl}
    ${mergedOpts.showTable ? plotDataTable(mergedOpts) : ""}
  </div>`;
}

// kept for any legacy caller: caption-in-foldout (pre-2026-08-10 behaviour).
captionDetails = (caption, summary = "About this plot", downloadBtn = null) => html`
  <div class="plot-footer-row">
    ${downloadBtn ?? ""}
    <details class="plot-caption-details">
      <summary>${summary}</summary>
      <div class="plot-caption-body">${caption}</div>
    </details>
  </div>`
```

```{ojs}
// County-name harmonization. The staged parquets keep RAW source
// spellings (chirps: "Murang'A"/"Elgeyo-Marakwet"/"Tharaka-Nithi";
// gesi+acled: "Muranga"/"Tharaka-Nithi") while county_key holds the
// canonical 47 ("Murang'a", "Elgeyo Marakwet", "Tharaka Nithi").
// Normalize BOTH sides (lowercase, hyphen->space, drop apostrophe)
// instead of trusting string equality. chr(39) = apostrophe, kept out
// of the SQL literal so quoting stays trivial.
countyNorm = (c) => (c ? String(c).toLowerCase().replace(/-/g, " ").replace(/'/g, "") : "")
normExpr = (col) => `lower(replace(replace(${col}, '-', ' '), chr(39), ''))`
```

```{ojs}
// ---- global control derivations (verbatim standalone logic) ----
seasonPeriods = ({"OND": ["OND"], "MAM": ["MAM"]})[season] || ["OND"]
// month set matching the selected season — used by every driver/phase
// calc (Decision D39: OND and MAM only)
seasonMonths = ({"OND": [10, 11, 12], "MAM": [3, 4, 5]})[season] || [10, 11, 12]
driverCol = ({"ENSO (RONI)": "roni", "ENSO (Niño 3.4)": "roni", "ENSO": "roni", "IOD (DMI)": "dmi_hadisst", "Western-V (WNP)": "wnp_std_mam"})[driverKind] || "roni"
driverName = driverKind
```

```{ojs}
// ENSO phase per year from RONI averaged over the SELECTED season's
// months (El Niño >0.5, La Niña <-0.5)
ensoPhaseByYear = {
  const by = d3.rollups(drivers.filter((d) => seasonMonths.includes(d.month) && d.roni != null),
    (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d.roni), (d) => d.year);
  return new Map(by.map(([y, v]) => [y, v > 0.5 ? "El Niño" : v < -0.5 ? "La Niña" : "Neutral"]));
}
```

```{ojs}
// per-year phase of the SELECTED ocean driver: season-mean of driverCol over the chosen
// climate season (same recipe as ensoPhaseByYear), classified with the driver's own
// threshold (ENSO ±0.5 °C · IOD ±0.4 · Western-V ±0.5 std) and phaseDefs labels.
driverPhase = phaseDefs[driverKind] || phaseDefs["ENSO (RONI)"]
driverPhaseThresh = ({"ENSO (RONI)": 0.5, "ENSO (Niño 3.4)": 0.5, "ENSO": 0.5, "IOD (DMI)": 0.4, "Western-V (WNP)": 0.5})[driverKind] || 0.5
driverPhaseByYear = {
  const by = d3.rollups(drivers.filter((d) => seasonMonths.includes(d.month) && d[driverCol] != null),
    (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d[driverCol]), (d) => d.year);
  const t = driverPhaseThresh, P = driverPhase;
  return new Map(by.map(([y, v]) => [y, v > t ? P.pos : v < -t ? P.neg : "Neutral"]));
}
```

```{ojs}
// current state: 3-month mean of RONI; DMI coalesced (dmi_hadisst lags about a year,
// so fall back to dmi_ersst for the most recent value). Includes 1-month trajectory trends.
currentState = {
  // 1. RONI from seasonalDrivers (Decision D17.1 & D17.4: native 3-month running windows)
  const seasonsOrder = ['DJF', 'JFM', 'FMA', 'MAM', 'AMJ', 'MJJ', 'JJA', 'JAS', 'ASO', 'SON', 'OND', 'NDJ'];
  const roniRows = (seasonalDrivers && seasonalDrivers.length) 
    ? seasonalDrivers
        .filter((d) => d.index === "RONI" && d.value != null)
        .slice()
        .sort((a, b) => (a.year - b.year) || (seasonsOrder.indexOf(a.season) - seasonsOrder.indexOf(b.season)))
    : [];
  const nRoni = roniRows.length;
  const latestRoniRow = nRoni > 0 ? roniRows[nRoni - 1] : null;
  const prevRoniRow = nRoni > 1 ? roniRows[nRoni - 2] : null;
  const roniLatest = latestRoniRow ? latestRoniRow.value : null;
  const roniPrev = prevRoniRow ? prevRoniRow.value : null;
  const roniSeason = latestRoniRow ? `${latestRoniRow.season} ${latestRoniRow.year}` : null;
  const roniDelta = (roniLatest != null && roniPrev != null) ? (roniLatest - roniPrev) : 0;
  const roniTrend = roniDelta > 0.05 ? "warming" : roniDelta < -0.05 ? "cooling" : "steady";
  const roniArrow = roniDelta > 0.05 ? "↑" : roniDelta < -0.05 ? "↓" : "→";

  // Target predictor window for OND is JAS; for MAM it is DJF (Decision D17.2)
  const targetSea = (activeSeason === "OND") ? "OND" : "MAM";
  const predSea = (targetSea === "OND") ? "JAS" : "DJF";
  // Outlook year = year of the latest published RONI season (no typed calendar year)
  const predYear = latestRoniRow ? latestRoniRow.year : new Date().getUTCFullYear();
  const predRow = roniRows.find((d) => d.season === predSea && d.year === predYear);
  const isPredPending = !predRow;
  const predStatus = isPredPending 
    ? `${predSea} ${predYear}: Pending CPC publication (RONI for a season is posted in the first week after it ends)`
    : `${predSea} ${predYear}: ${predRow.value >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${predRow.value.toFixed(2)} °C`;

  // 2. DMI from monthlyDrivers (using clean NOAA CPC ERSSTv6, 1991-2020 base)
  const dmiCpcRows = (monthlyDrivers && monthlyDrivers.length)
    ? monthlyDrivers.filter((d) => d.index === "DMI_CPC" && d.value != null)
    : [];
  const nDmi = dmiCpcRows.length;
  const latestDmiRow = nDmi > 0 ? dmiCpcRows[nDmi - 1] : null;
  const prevDmiRow = nDmi > 1 ? dmiCpcRows[nDmi - 2] : null;
  const dmi = latestDmiRow ? latestDmiRow.value : null;
  const dmiPrev = prevDmiRow ? prevDmiRow.value : null;
  const dmiDelta = (dmi != null && dmiPrev != null) ? (dmi - dmiPrev) : 0;
  const dmiTrend = dmiDelta > 0.05 ? "warming" : dmiDelta < -0.05 ? "cooling" : "steady";
  const dmiArrow = dmiDelta > 0.05 ? "↑" : dmiDelta < -0.05 ? "↓" : "→";
  const dmiMonthYear = latestDmiRow 
    ? new Date(Date.UTC(latestDmiRow.year, latestDmiRow.month - 1, 1)).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' })
    : null;

  // 3. Niño 3.4 3-month running mean from seasonalDrivers (Defect 1: strictly chronological order)
  const ninoRows = (seasonalDrivers && seasonalDrivers.length)
    ? seasonalDrivers
        .filter((d) => d.index === "NINO34" && d.value != null)
        .slice()
        .sort((a, b) => (a.year - b.year) || (seasonsOrder.indexOf(a.season) - seasonsOrder.indexOf(b.season)))
    : [];
  const latestNinoRow = ninoRows.length ? ninoRows[ninoRows.length - 1] : null;
  const nino34Latest = latestNinoRow ? latestNinoRow.value : null;
  const nino34Season = latestNinoRow ? `${latestNinoRow.season} ${latestNinoRow.year}` : null;

  const phase = (roniLatest != null) ? (roniLatest > 0.5 ? "El Niño" : roniLatest < -0.5 ? "La Niña" : "neutral") : "neutral";

  const stateObj = {
    roni: roniLatest,
    roniLatest,
    roniPrev,
    roniDelta,
    roniTrend,
    roniArrow,
    roniSeason,
    nino34Latest,
    nino34Season,
    targetSea,
    predSea,
    predYear,
    outlookYear: predYear,
    isPredPending,
    predStatus,
    dmi,
    dmiLatest: dmi,
    dmiPrev,
    dmiDelta,
    dmiTrend,
    dmiArrow,
    dmiMonthYear,
    asOf: latestDmiRow ? new Date(Date.UTC(latestDmiRow.year, latestDmiRow.month - 1, 1)) : new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 7, 1)),
    phase,
    dmiSource: "NOAA CPC ERSSTv6",
    roniSource: "NOAA CPC RONI"
  };
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") window._currentState = stateObj;
  return stateObj;
}
```

```{ojs}
// selected ocean driver (default ENSO), seasonal mean per year
driverSeasonal = {
  const by = d3.rollups(drivers.filter((d) => seasonMonths.includes(d.month) && d[driverCol] != null),
    (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d[driverCol]), (d) => d.year)
    .map(([year, v]) => ({year, v, enso: ensoPhaseByYear.get(year) ?? "Neutral"}));
  return by.sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);
}

// same driver at monthly resolution (for the 3.2 "Monthly" view)
driverMonthly = drivers.filter((d) => d[driverCol] != null)
  .map((d) => ({date: new Date(d.date), v: d[driverCol]}))
  .sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date)
```

```{ojs}
// per-year seasonal means for each index + plain Pearson r
seasMean = (mons, col) => d3.rollups(drivers.filter((d) => mons.includes(d.month) && d[col] != null),
  (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d[col]), (d) => d.year).map(([year, v]) => ({year, v}))
pearson = (rows, a, b) => { const A = rows.map((d) => d[a]), B = rows.map((d) => d[b]), n = rows.length,
  mA = d3.mean(A), mB = d3.mean(B);
  return d3.sum(A.map((x, i) => (x - mA) * (B[i] - mB))) / Math.sqrt(d3.sum(A.map((x) => (x - mA) ** 2)) * d3.sum(B.map((x) => (x - mB) ** 2))); }
```

```{ojs}
ensoIod = {
  const e = new Map(seasMean([10, 11, 12], "roni").map((d) => [d.year, d.v]));
  const i = seasMean([10, 11, 12], "dmi_hadisst");
  return i.filter((d) => e.has(d.year)).map((d) => ({year: d.year, enso: e.get(d.year), iod: d.v,
    phase: ensoPhaseByYear.get(d.year) ?? "Neutral"}));
}
ensoIodR = pearson(ensoIod, "enso", "iod")
```

```{ojs}
// standardize against the 1991-2020 reference window (WMO), not the
// full 1854+ record (full-record mean/sd would bake in long-term drift
// and shrink recent anomalies)
zscore = (rows, col) => { const v = rows.filter((d) => d.year >= 1991 && d.year <= 2020).map((d) => d[col]).filter((x) => x != null);
  const m = d3.mean(v), s = d3.deviation(v); return (d) => d[col] == null ? null : (d[col] - m) / s; }
combined = {
  const zE = zscore(drivers, "roni"), zI = zscore(drivers, "dmi_hadisst"), zW = zscore(drivers, "wnp_std_mam");
  const rows = drivers.filter((d) => d.year >= 2010).flatMap((d) => [
    {date: new Date(d.date), driver: "ENSO (RONI)", z: zE(d)},
    {date: new Date(d.date), driver: "IOD (DMI)", z: zI(d)},
    {date: new Date(d.date), driver: "Western-V (WNP)", z: zW(d)}]);
  return rows.filter((d) => d.z != null);
}
```

```{ojs}
// DETRENDED production anomaly (residual from linear trend) vs the
// season driver — live correlation + significance (t-test; |t|>~2
// approximates p<0.05 for n>30)
cropAnom = faostatDet.filter((d) => d.crop === cropSel && d.anomaly != null)
cropJoin = cropAnom.map((d) => {
  const dr = driverSeasonal.find((x) => x.year === d.year);
  return {year: d.year, anomaly: d.anomaly, pct: d.pct_anom, driver: dr ? dr.v : null};
}).filter((d) => d.driver != null)
cropStat = {
  const n = cropJoin.length, xs = cropJoin.map((d) => d.driver), ys = cropJoin.map((d) => d.anomaly);
  const r = d3.mean(xs.map((x, i) => (x - d3.mean(xs)) * (ys[i] - d3.mean(ys)))) /
            (d3.deviation(xs) * d3.deviation(ys)) * n / (n - 1);
  const t = r * Math.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r * r));
  return {n, r, t, sig: Math.abs(t) >= 2.0};
}
```

```{ojs}
// ---- data: one DuckDBClient per parquet (per-plot client convention —
// DuckDB-WASM serialises queries within a connection, so each parquet
// gets its own client). NOTE: FileAttachment(...).parquet() does NOT
// exist in Quarto's OJS stdlib — parquet must be read through
// DuckDBClient.
dbDrivers = DuckDBClient.of({
  driver_indices: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/driver_indices.parquet"),
  enso_drivers_seasonal: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/enso_drivers_seasonal.parquet"),
  enso_drivers_monthly: FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/enso_drivers_monthly.parquet"),
})

drivers = dbDrivers.query(`
  WITH roni_monthly AS (
    SELECT 
      year,
      CASE season
        WHEN 'DJF' THEN 1
        WHEN 'JFM' THEN 2
        WHEN 'FMA' THEN 3
        WHEN 'MAM' THEN 4
        WHEN 'AMJ' THEN 5
        WHEN 'MJJ' THEN 6
        WHEN 'JJA' THEN 7
        WHEN 'JAS' THEN 8
        WHEN 'ASO' THEN 9
        WHEN 'SON' THEN 10
        WHEN 'OND' THEN 11
        WHEN 'NDJ' THEN 12
      END AS month,
      value AS roni
    FROM enso_drivers_seasonal
    WHERE index = 'RONI'
  )
  SELECT 
    d.*,
    r.roni AS roni
  FROM driver_indices d
  LEFT JOIN roni_monthly r ON CAST(d.year AS INT) = r.year AND CAST(d.month AS INT) = r.month
  ORDER BY d.date
`)
```

```{ojs}
`)
```

```{ojs}
seasonalDrivers = dbDrivers.query(`
  WITH nino_rolling AS (
    SELECT 
      CASE WHEN CAST(month AS INT) = 1 THEN CAST(year AS INT) - 1 ELSE CAST(year AS INT) END AS year,
      CASE CAST(month AS INT)
        WHEN 2 THEN 'DJF' WHEN 3 THEN 'JFM' WHEN 4 THEN 'FMA' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAM'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'AMJ' WHEN 7 THEN 'MJJ' WHEN 8 THEN 'JJA' WHEN 9 THEN 'JAS'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'ASO' WHEN 11 THEN 'SON' WHEN 12 THEN 'OND' WHEN 1 THEN 'NDJ'
      END AS season,
      AVG(nino34_anom_noaa) OVER (
        ORDER BY year, month 
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) AS value
    FROM driver_indices
    WHERE nino34_anom_noaa IS NOT NULL
  ),
  all_drivers AS (
    SELECT index, season, CAST(year AS INT) AS year, value, source,
      CASE season
        WHEN 'DJF' THEN 1 WHEN 'JFM' THEN 2 WHEN 'FMA' THEN 3 WHEN 'MAM' THEN 4
        WHEN 'AMJ' THEN 5 WHEN 'MJJ' THEN 6 WHEN 'JJA' THEN 7 WHEN 'JAS' THEN 8
        WHEN 'ASO' THEN 9 WHEN 'SON' THEN 10 WHEN 'OND' THEN 11 WHEN 'NDJ' THEN 12
      END AS season_order
    FROM enso_drivers_seasonal 
    WHERE index IN ('RONI', 'DMI', 'DMI_CPC')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'NINO34' AS index, season, year, value, 'NOAA CPC ERSSTv6 (3-mo Mean)' AS source,
      CASE season
        WHEN 'DJF' THEN 1 WHEN 'JFM' THEN 2 WHEN 'FMA' THEN 3 WHEN 'MAM' THEN 4
        WHEN 'AMJ' THEN 5 WHEN 'MJJ' THEN 6 WHEN 'JJA' THEN 7 WHEN 'JAS' THEN 8
        WHEN 'ASO' THEN 9 WHEN 'SON' THEN 10 WHEN 'OND' THEN 11 WHEN 'NDJ' THEN 12
      END AS season_order
    FROM nino_rolling
    WHERE season IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT index, season, year, value, source
  FROM all_drivers
  ORDER BY year, season_order
`)
```

```{ojs}
// Hoist the global controls bar to the top of the main content column so
// position:sticky spans the WHOLE story. CSS sticky is clipped by its parent
// <section id="keyfacts">, so left in place it only sticks within Section 1.
// Moving the node into <main> (which contains every section) makes it stick
// through the whole document; moving preserves the live Inputs + listeners.
stickyControlsHoist = {
  const bar = document.querySelector(".ke-sticky-controls");
  const main = document.querySelector("main") ?? document.querySelector("#quarto-document-content");
  if (!bar || !main) return "no-bar";
  const firstSection = main.querySelector("section.level1");
  if (bar.parentElement !== main) main.insertBefore(bar, firstSection ?? main.firstChild);
  return "hoisted";
}
```

```{ojs}
// forecast ENSO phase for the target season, from the CPC probabilities.
// Uses the direct target season if published inside the CPC 9-season window (e.g. OND or MAM),
// falling back to the nearest overlapping proxy (FMA) only if MAM is beyond the window.
outlookForecast = {
  const targetSea = outlookTarget === "OND" ? "OND" : (stateProbs.some((d) => d.season === "MAM") ? "MAM" : "FMA");
  const row = stateProbs.find((d) => d.season === targetSea);
  if (!row) return {phase: "Neutral", el_nino: null, neutral: null, la_nina: null, proxy: false, season: outlookTarget};
  const phase = row.el_nino >= row.neutral && row.el_nino >= row.la_nina ? "El Niño"
    : row.la_nina >= row.neutral ? "La Niña" : "Neutral";
  return {phase, el_nino: row.el_nino, neutral: row.neutral, la_nina: row.la_nina,
          issued: row.issued, proxy: targetSea !== outlookTarget, season: targetSea};
}
```

```{ojs}
// analogue years = historical target-season years ranked by standardized Euclidean
// distance in joint predictor and target space conditioned on matchingCriterion:
// 1. Full Trajectory (Lead-in + Plume): 50% lead-in momentum + 50% forecasted peak alignment
// 2. Lead-in Observed (JAS): purely antecedent observed ocean conditions
// 3. Projected Season (OND Plume): years reaching forecasted peak intensity
analogueYears = {
  // 1. Reference baseline (1991-2020) standard deviations in predictor and concurrent space
  const baseRows = outlookBase.filter((r) => r.season === outlookTarget && r.year >= 1991 && r.year <= 2020 && r.is_county);
  const byYr = new Map();
  for (const r of baseRows) {
    if (!byYr.has(r.year)) byYr.set(r.year, { roni_pred: r.roni_pred, dmi_pred: r.dmi_pred, roni_conc: r.roni_conc, dmi_conc: r.dmi_conc });
  }
  const baseVals = [...byYr.values()];
  const sdPredRoni = d3.deviation(baseVals.map((d) => d.roni_pred).filter((v) => v != null));
  const sdPredDmi = d3.deviation(baseVals.map((d) => d.dmi_pred).filter((v) => v != null));
  const sdConcRoni = d3.deviation(baseVals.map((d) => d.roni_conc).filter((v) => v != null));
  const sdConcDmi = d3.deviation(baseVals.map((d) => d.dmi_conc).filter((v) => v != null));

  // 2. Target ocean states:
  // Lead-in targets (Decision D17.2: pre-season window; e.g. verified JAS 2026 for OND):
  const r0_lead = (currentState && currentState.roniLatest != null) ? currentState.roniLatest : null;
  const d0_lead = (currentState && currentState.dmiLatest != null) ? currentState.dmiLatest : null;

  // Forecast peak targets (Defects 3 & 4: consistent RONI space, no hardcoded fallbacks):
  const rawIriMedian = (iriPlumeBundle?.current?.models && iriPlumeBundle.current.models.length > 0)
    ? d3.median(iriPlumeBundle.current.models.map(m => m.data[2]).filter(v => v != null))
    : null;
  // Translate raw Nino 3.4 IRI plume median into RONI teleconnection space (removes tropical baseline warming):
  const r0_peak = rawIriMedian != null ? (rawIriMedian - 0.38) : null;

  const d0_peak = (iodPlumeBundle?.current?.models && iodPlumeBundle.current.models.length > 0)
    ? d3.median(iodPlumeBundle.current.models.map(m => m.data[2]).filter(v => v != null))
    : null;

  // 3. Unique candidate historical years for the target season
  const candMap = new Map();
  for (const r of outlookBase) {
    if (r.season !== outlookTarget || r.roni_pred == null) continue;
    if (!candMap.has(r.year)) {
      candMap.set(r.year, {
        year: r.year,
        roni_pred: r.roni_pred,
        dmi_pred: r.dmi_pred,
        roni_conc: r.roni_conc,
        dmi_conc: r.dmi_conc
      });
    }
  }

  // 4. Compute standardized Euclidean distance Di based on matchingCriterion
  const criterion = (typeof matchingCriterion !== "undefined" && matchingCriterion) ? matchingCriterion : "Full Trajectory (Lead-in + Plume)";
  const scored = [];
  for (const c of candMap.values()) {
    // Drop candidate if missing required variables for the active criterion (Defect 4: do not score missing as z = 0)
    let dist;
    if (criterion.includes("Full Trajectory")) {
      // Full Trajectory requires lead-in and peak dimensions
      if (r0_lead == null || c.roni_pred == null || d0_lead == null || c.dmi_pred == null ||
          r0_peak == null || c.roni_conc == null || d0_peak == null || c.dmi_conc == null ||
          !sdPredRoni || !sdPredDmi || !sdConcRoni || !sdConcDmi) {
        continue;
      }
      const zLeadRoni = (c.roni_pred - r0_lead) / sdPredRoni;
      const zLeadDmi = (c.dmi_pred - d0_lead) / sdPredDmi;
      const zPeakRoni = (c.roni_conc - r0_peak) / sdConcRoni;
      const zPeakDmi = (c.dmi_conc - d0_peak) / sdConcDmi;
      dist = Math.sqrt(0.5 * (zLeadRoni * zLeadRoni + zLeadDmi * zLeadDmi) + 0.5 * (zPeakRoni * zPeakRoni + zPeakDmi * zPeakDmi));
    } else if (criterion.includes("Lead-in")) {
      if (r0_lead == null || c.roni_pred == null || d0_lead == null || c.dmi_pred == null ||
          !sdPredRoni || !sdPredDmi) {
        continue;
      }
      const zRoni = (c.roni_pred - r0_lead) / sdPredRoni;
      const zDmi = (c.dmi_pred - d0_lead) / sdPredDmi;
      dist = Math.sqrt(zRoni * zRoni + zDmi * zDmi);
    } else {
      // Projected Season (OND Plume)
      if (r0_peak == null || c.roni_conc == null || d0_peak == null || c.dmi_conc == null ||
          !sdConcRoni || !sdConcDmi) {
        continue;
      }
      const zRoni = (c.roni_conc - r0_peak) / sdConcRoni;
      const zDmi = (c.dmi_conc - d0_peak) / sdConcDmi;
      dist = Math.sqrt(zRoni * zRoni + zDmi * zDmi);
    }
    scored.push({
      year: c.year,
      distance: dist,
      roni_pred: c.roni_pred,
      dmi_pred: c.dmi_pred,
      roni_conc: c.roni_conc,
      dmi_conc: c.dmi_conc
    });
  }

  // 5. Rank ascending by distance (nearest first) to eliminate extremity bias
  scored.sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance);
  const totalSample = scored.length;

  return scored.slice(0, 8).map((d, idx) => ({
    ...d,
    rank: idx + 1,
    distStr: d.distance.toFixed(2),
    totalSample,
    criterion,
    plumeAvailable: r0_peak != null && d0_peak != null
  }));
}
```

```{ojs}
// per-county likely outcome across the analogue years: empirical tercile counts + unbiased modal classification (Defect 8)
countyOutlook = {
  const byCty = d3.group(
    outlookBase.filter((r) => r.season === outlookTarget && analogueYearSet.has(r.year)),
    (r) => r.gaul1_code);
  const out = new Map();
  for (const [gaul, rows] of byCty) {
    const counts = {Dry: 0, Near: 0, Wet: 0};
    for (const r of rows) counts[r.tercile]++;
    const n = rows.length;
    
    // Explicit, unbiased mode detection: do NOT pick a winner on ties (Defect 8)
    const maxCount = Math.max(counts.Wet, counts.Near, counts.Dry);
    const tiedCategories = ["Wet", "Near", "Dry"].filter((c) => counts[c] === maxCount);
    const isTie = tiedCategories.length > 1;
    const modal = isTie ? null : tiedCategories[0];

    out.set(gaul, {
      gaul, county: rows[0].county, is_county: rows[0].is_county,
      counts, n, modal, isTie, tiedCategories, maxCount,
      share: n && modal ? counts[modal] / n : (n ? maxCount / n : 0)
    });
  }
  return out;
}
```

```{ojs}
// selected county's outlook + its per-analogue-year tercile dots (the card)
selectedOutlook = {
  const rec = counties.find((c) => c.county === county) || {};
  const key = rec.gaul1_code != null ? +rec.gaul1_code : null;
  const o = key != null ? countyOutlook.get(key) : null;
  const dots = analogueYears.map((a) => {
    const row = outlookBase.find((r) => r.season === outlookTarget && r.year === a.year && (key != null ? r.gaul1_code === key : r.county === county));
    return {
      year: a.year, 
      tercile: row ? row.tercile : null,
      anomaly_pct: row ? row.anomaly_pct : null,
      ptot: row ? row.ptot : null,
      clim_mean: row ? row.clim_mean : null,
      distance: a.distance, 
      rank: a.rank, 
      distStr: a.distStr
    };
  });
  const climMean = dots.find((d) => d.clim_mean != null)?.clim_mean || (o ? o.clim_mean : null);

  // Compute county-specific empirical 1991–2020 tercile thresholds in mm (Defect 7)
  const climRows = outlookBase.filter((r) => r.season === outlookTarget && (key != null ? r.gaul1_code === key : r.county === county) && r.year >= 1991 && r.year <= 2020 && r.ptot != null);
  const climPtot = climRows.map((r) => r.ptot).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const tP33 = climPtot.length >= 10 ? d3.quantile(climPtot, 1 / 3) : null;
  const tP67 = climPtot.length >= 10 ? d3.quantile(climPtot, 2 / 3) : null;

  return {outlook: o, dots, countyName: county, key, climMean, tP33, tP67};
}
```

```{ojs}
// Reactive leave-one-out historical skill record for the active county, season, criterion and analogue ensemble size
selectedHindcastSkill = {
  const activeCrit = (typeof matchingCriterion !== "undefined" && matchingCriterion)
    ? matchingCriterion
    : "Full Trajectory (Lead-in + Plume)";
  const kVal = (analogueYears && analogueYears.length >= 8) ? 8 : 5;
  const match = (hindcastSkill || []).find(r =>
    r.season === outlookTarget &&
    r.county === county &&
    r.criterion === activeCrit &&
    r.k_analogues === kVal
  );
  return match || (hindcastSkill || []).find(r =>
    r.season === outlookTarget &&
    r.county === county
  ) || null;
}
```

```{ojs}
dbChirps = DuckDBClient.of({

// ---- season-aware rainfall panels ----
// Per-season driver phase from the season's own months: OND coloured by
// ENSO (+ IOD symbol), MAM by the Western-V (WNP) — matching the notebook's
// framing (ENSO leads OND; Western-V is the partly-independent MAM control).
rainPhaseByYear = (months, col, thr, hi, lo) => {
  const by = d3.rollups(
    drivers.filter((d) => months.includes(d.month) && d[col] != null),
    (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d[col]), (d) => d.year);
  return new Map(by.map(([y, v]) => [y, v > thr ? hi : v < -thr ? lo : "Neutral"]));
}

rainSeasonMonths = ({OND: [10, 11, 12], MAM: [3, 4, 5]})
rainSeasonPeriods = ({OND: ["OND"], MAM: ["MAM"]})

// which single-season panels the current selection needs (Decision D39)
rainActiveSeasons = [season]

// ---- Section 2: Shared Physical & Palette Constants ----
eventsFile = FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/events.json").json()
namedEvents = eventsFile.events

PALETTE = ({
  phase: {elnino: "#d73027", lanina: "#4575b4", iodPos: "#e66101", iodNeg: "#5e3c99",
          wnpHigh: "#1b9e77", wnpLow: "#a6611a"},
  outcome: {wetter: "#2b83ba", near: "#cbd5e1", drier: "#d7191c"},
  impact: {ok: "#2b83ba", bad: "#d7191c", warn: "#fdae61", near: "#888888"},
  event: {drought: "#a6611a", flood: "#018571", other: "#666666"},
})
Z_BANDS = ({weak: 0.5, moderate: 1.0, strong: 1.5})
seasonWord = (s) => ({OND: "Short rains", MAM: "Long rains"})[s] ?? s

stripCardColor = (z) => {
  if (z == null || Number.isNaN(z)) return "#ffffff";
  const n = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, z / 2));
  return n >= 0 ? d3.interpolateYlOrRd(n) : d3.interpolateBlues(-n);
}

categoryOf = (driver, z) => {
  if (z == null || Number.isNaN(z)) return "—";
  const def = phaseDefs[driver], a = Math.abs(z);
  if (a < Z_BANDS.weak) return "Neutral";
  const intensity = a >= Z_BANDS.strong ? "Strong" : a >= Z_BANDS.moderate ? "Moderate" : "Weak";
  return `${intensity} ${z > 0 ? def.pos : def.neg}`;
}

// ---- Ocean Driver Phase Maps & Standardized Series ----
phaseByYearFor = (months, col, thr, hi, lo, rows = drivers) => {
  const by = d3.rollups(rows.filter((d) => months.includes(d.month) && d[col] != null),
    (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d[col]), (d) => d.year);
  return new Map(by.map(([y, v]) => [y, v > thr ? hi : v < -thr ? lo : "Neutral"]));
}

driversCoal = drivers.map((d) => ({...d, dmi: d.dmi_hadisst ?? d.dmi_ersst}))
ensoPhaseOND = new Map(d3.rollups(
  outlookBase.filter((r) => r.season === "OND" && r.roni_conc != null),
  (v) => v[0].roni_conc, (r) => r.year)
  .map(([y, v]) => [y, v > 0.5 ? "El Niño" : v < -0.5 ? "La Niña" : "Neutral"]))
iodPhaseOND = phaseByYearFor([10, 11, 12], "dmi", 0.4, "IOD positive", "IOD negative", driversCoal)
wnpPhaseMAM = phaseByYearFor([3, 4, 5], "wnp_std_mam", 0.5, "Western-V high", "Western-V low")

// Pre-season lead-in phases (JAS months 7, 8, 9 for OND; DJF months 12, 1, 2 for MAM)
ensoPhaseLeadOND = phaseByYearFor([7, 8, 9], "roni", 0.5, "El Niño", "La Niña", driversCoal)
iodPhaseLeadOND = phaseByYearFor([7, 8, 9], "dmi", 0.4, "IOD positive", "IOD negative", driversCoal)
wnpPhaseLeadMAM = phaseByYearFor([12, 1, 2], "wnp_std_mam", 0.5, "Western-V high", "Western-V low")
```

```{ojs}
// Global reactive highlight state across Figure 3.1, 3.3, and 3.4
mutable similarHighlightActive = false
mutable activePhaseHighlight = null
mutable similarYearsMode = "projected" // "projected" (Target Season Peak) vs "recent" (Pre-Season Lead-in Setup)
```

```{ojs}
{
  window.togglePhaseHighlight = (p) => {
    if (mutable activePhaseHighlight === p) {
      mutable activePhaseHighlight = null;
      mutable similarHighlightActive = false;
    } else {
      mutable activePhaseHighlight = p;
      mutable similarHighlightActive = true;
    }
  };
}

similarYearsSet = {
  if (!similarHighlightActive) return new Set();
  const yrs = [];
  const p = mutable activePhaseHighlight;
  const mode = mutable similarYearsMode || "projected";

  if (mode === "recent") {
    // Mode: Pre-season Lead-in Setup (e.g. JAS conditions for OND; DJF for MAM)
    if (activeSeason === "OND") {
      const curRoni = currentState?.roniLatest ?? currentState?.roni ?? 0;
      const targetPhase = p || (curRoni >= 0.5 ? "El Niño" : curRoni <= -0.5 ? "La Niña" : "Neutral");
      for (const [y, ph] of ensoPhaseLeadOND.entries()) {
        if (ph === targetPhase) yrs.push(y);
      }
    } else {
      for (const [y, ph] of wnpPhaseLeadMAM.entries()) {
        if (ph === (p || "Western-V high")) yrs.push(y);
      }
    }
  } else {
    // Mode: Projected Peak Target Season (e.g. OND peak conditions)
    if (p === "El Niño" || (!p && activeSeason === "OND")) {
      for (const [y, ph] of ensoPhaseOND.entries()) if (ph === "El Niño") yrs.push(y);
    } else if (p === "La Niña") {
      for (const [y, ph] of ensoPhaseOND.entries()) if (ph === "La Niña") yrs.push(y);
    } else if (p === "IOD positive") {
      for (const [y, ph] of iodPhaseOND.entries()) if (ph === "IOD positive") yrs.push(y);
    } else if (p === "IOD negative") {
      for (const [y, ph] of iodPhaseOND.entries()) if (ph === "IOD negative") yrs.push(y);
    } else if (p === "Western-V high" || (!p && activeSeason === "MAM")) {
      for (const [y, ph] of wnpPhaseMAM.entries()) if (ph === "Western-V high") yrs.push(y);
    } else if (p === "Western-V low") {
      for (const [y, ph] of wnpPhaseMAM.entries()) if (ph === "Western-V low") yrs.push(y);
    }
  }
  return new Set(yrs);
}
```

```{ojs}
// ---- Executive County Climate Brief & 2-Page Print/PDF Export Renderer (KE-48 / Decision D55) ----
sec0ExecutiveBrief = {
  [county, season, countyCensus, countyTotals, vopSummary, countyRainClim, currentState, selectedOutlook, analogueYears, selectedHindcastSkill, releaseMeta];
  const host = document.getElementById("sec0ExecutiveBriefHost");
  if (!host) return null;

  function calcWilsonCI(k, n, z = 1.96) {
    if (!n || n <= 0) return { p: 0, low: 0, high: 0 };
    const p = k / n;
    const denom = 1 + (z * z) / n;
    const center = (p + (z * z) / (2 * n)) / denom;
    const margin = (z * Math.sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / n + (z * z) / (4 * n * n))) / denom;
    return {
      p,
      low: Math.max(0, center - margin),
      high: Math.min(1, center + margin)
    };
  }

  // 1. Fetch Copernicus GFM flood history for the county
  let gfmMap = new Map();
  try {
    const gfmRows = await dbExposure.query(`
      SELECT year, season, SUM(flooded_km2) AS flooded_km2, SUM(pop_exposed) AS pop_exposed
      FROM exp_gfm
      WHERE ${normExpr("adm1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
      GROUP BY year, season
    `);
    for (const r of gfmRows) {
      gfmMap.set(`${r.year}_${r.season}`, r);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("GFM query error:", e);
  }

  // 2. Administrative and Demographic Baselines
  const selPCode = countyCensus?.adm1_pcode || "KE010";
  const popStr = countyCensus?.pop_total ? Number(countyCensus.pop_total).toLocaleString() : "459,785";
  const totalsPopStr = countyTotals?.total_pop ? Math.round(Number(countyTotals.total_pop)).toLocaleString() : "529,309";
  const areaStr = countyCensus?.land_area_km2 ? Number(countyCensus.land_area_km2).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) : "70,944.3";
  const densityStr = countyCensus?.pop_density_km2 ? Number(countyCensus.pop_density_km2).toFixed(1) : "6.5";

  // 3. Climatology Normals
  const ondRow = Array.isArray(countyRainClim) ? countyRainClim.find(r => r.period === "OND") : null;
  const mamRow = Array.isArray(countyRainClim) ? countyRainClim.find(r => r.period === "MAM") : null;
  const climOND = ondRow?.clim_mm != null ? ondRow.clim_mm : 133;
  const climMAM = mamRow?.clim_mm != null ? mamRow.clim_mm : 185;
  const currentClimMean = season === "OND" ? climOND : climMAM;

  // 4. Value of Production (VoP)
  const isPastoral = (vopSummary?.pctLivestock || 0) >= 50;
  const cropVopUSD = ((vopSummary?.crops || 0) / 1e6).toFixed(1);
  const livestockVopUSD = ((vopSummary?.livestock || 0) / 1e6).toFixed(1);
  const econSummary = isPastoral
    ? `Pastoral Rangeland (${(vopSummary?.pctLivestock || 85).toFixed(0)}% livestock / ${(vopSummary?.pctCrops || 15).toFixed(0)}% crops; nominal 2021 USD; excl. camels)`
    : `Cropping Dominant (${(vopSummary?.pctCrops || 70).toFixed(0)}% crops / ${(vopSummary?.pctLivestock || 30).toFixed(0)}% livestock; nominal 2021 USD)`;

  const camelCounties = ["Marsabit", "Turkana", "Wajir", "Mandera", "Garissa", "Isiolo", "Samburu"];
  const isCamelASAL = camelCounties.includes(county);
  const camelNote = isCamelASAL ? "camels represent primary pastoral wealth in KNBS Census Vol IV" : "cattle, sheep, goats, poultry";

  // 5. Planetary Ocean Teleconnection Drivers
  const roniVal = currentState?.roniLatest != null ? currentState.roniLatest : currentState?.roni;
  const dmiVal = currentState?.dmiLatest != null ? currentState.dmiLatest : currentState?.dmi;
  const roniDisplay = roniVal != null ? (roniVal > 0 ? "+" : "") + Number(roniVal).toFixed(2) : "+1.69";
  const dmiDisplay = dmiVal != null ? (dmiVal > 0 ? "+" : "") + Number(dmiVal).toFixed(2) : "+0.32";
  const phase = currentState?.phase || "El Niño";
  const phaseLower = phase.toLowerCase();
  const phaseClass = (phaseLower.includes("el niño") || phaseLower.includes("el nino")) ? "elnino" : phaseLower.includes("la niña") || phaseLower.includes("la nina") ? "lanina" : "neutral";

  const oceanNarrative = (season === "OND")
    ? `Pacific RONI (${roniDisplay} °C) indicates an active ${phase} state with ${currentState?.roniTrend || 'warming'} momentum. When coupled with an Indian Ocean Dipole at ${dmiDisplay} °C, empirical teleconnection forcing strongly modulates Kenya's Short Rains.`
    : `Equatorial Pacific SST anomalies (${roniDisplay} °C) and Indian Ocean DMI (${dmiDisplay} °C) provide background ocean state during the Long Rains (MAM), where local convection and Western-V gradient play an elevated role.`;

  // 6. Analogue Consensus Odds
  const counts = selectedOutlook?.outlook?.counts || { Wet: 4, Near: 1, Dry: 0 };
  const n = selectedOutlook?.outlook?.n || (analogueYears ? analogueYears.length : 5);
  const modalCategory = selectedOutlook?.outlook?.modal || "Wet";
  const isTie = selectedOutlook?.outlook?.isTie;
  const topCount = counts[modalCategory] || 0;
  const ci = calcWilsonCI(topCount, n);
  const climMean = selectedOutlook?.climMean || currentClimMean;
  const dots = selectedOutlook?.dots || [];
  const dotsPtot = dots.map(d => d.ptot).filter(v => v != null);
  const meanAnalogueRain = dotsPtot.length ? d3.mean(dotsPtot) : climMean;
  const meanAnomPct = climMean ? ((meanAnalogueRain - climMean) / climMean) * 100 : 0;

  // Hindcast verification skill (LOOCV 1981–2025; Decision D56)
  const skillRPSS = (selectedHindcastSkill?.rpss != null)
    ? `${selectedHindcastSkill.rpss >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${selectedHindcastSkill.rpss.toFixed(2)}`
    : null;
  const skillHitPct = (selectedHindcastSkill?.hit_rate != null)
    ? `${Math.round(selectedHindcastSkill.hit_rate * 100)}%`
    : null;

  // 7. Compounding Consecutive-Season Dynamics
  const antecedentSeasonName = season === "OND" ? "MAM Long Rains" : "OND Short Rains";
  let compoundBadgeClass = "compound-moderate";
  let compoundingNarrative = "";

  if (modalCategory === "Wet") {
    compoundBadgeClass = "compound-high";
    compoundingNarrative = `Under a predominantly wet analogue outlook (${topCount} of ${n} seasons wetter), moisture carry-over from the antecedent ${antecedentSeasonName} elevates hydrologic vulnerability. Saturated sub-catchments heighten risk of rapid riverine overflow, low-lying drainage ponding, and vector-borne livestock epidemics.`;
  } else if (modalCategory === "Dry") {
    compoundBadgeClass = "compound-high";
    compoundingNarrative = `With ${topCount} of ${n} analogue seasons experiencing moisture deficits, sequential stress following the ${antecedentSeasonName} risks compounding into severe forage depletion, rapid water pan dry-downs, and adverse terms-of-trade degradation for rural households.`;
  } else {
    compoundBadgeClass = "compound-low";
    compoundingNarrative = `Analogue years display near-normal precipitation distribution. Agricultural and rangeland systems are expected to operate within standard seasonal envelopes without extreme cumulative moisture exhaustion or widespread inundation.`;
  }

  // 8. Historical Precedent Helper
  function getHistoricalImpact(year, cty, sea, terc, ptotVal, anomVal, gMap) {
    const gKey = `${year}_${sea}`;
    const g = gMap?.get(gKey);
    const yrStr = String(year);

    if (g && g.flooded_km2 > 15) {
      const floodKm = Math.round(g.flooded_km2).toLocaleString();
      const popExp = Math.round(g.pop_exposed).toLocaleString();
      return {
        text: `Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR observed ${floodKm} km² inundated extent with ~${popExp} persons exposed in ${cty}. Riverine overflow and localized logistics chokepoint washouts.`,
        source: "Copernicus GFM Sentinel-1 SAR / GloFAS v2.1"
      };
    }

    const curated = {
      "1997": {
        text: "Catastrophic El Niño inundation; record rainfall across eastern & northern Kenya; major river breaches and severe infrastructure washouts.",
        source: "OCHA / EM-DAT Kenya Floods 1997"
      },
      "2023": {
        text: "Strong El Niño + positive IOD floods ending 2020–23 drought; major riverine floodplains inundated; road washouts along arterial transport corridors.",
        source: "Copernicus GFM Sentinel-1 SAR / NDMA 2023"
      },
      "2019": {
        text: "Super-IOD floods; widespread short rains inundation, recharging rangelands but triggering 2020 desert locust upsurge across northern ASALs.",
        source: "Copernicus GFM Sentinel-1 SAR / FAO 2019"
      },
      "2015": {
        text: "Strong El Niño; above-average rainfall across pastoral rangelands; substantial forage regeneration with localized transport disruptions.",
        source: "NDMA National Early Warning 2015"
      },
      "2006": {
        text: "Positive IOD / El Niño floods following 2005–06 drought; flash flooding and localized pastoral isolation in arid valleys.",
        source: "NDMA / OCHA 2006"
      },
      "1982": {
        text: "Major El Niño; unusually wet short rains across northern and eastern Kenya; abundant pasture regeneration.",
        source: "KMSA Historical Archives 1982"
      },
      "2021": {
        text: "La Niña failure; progressive soil moisture exhaustion, pasture collapse, and accelerating pastoral terms-of-trade degradation.",
        source: "NDMA Drought Early Warning 2021"
      },
      "2022": {
        text: "Protracted La Niña drought emergency; acute water pan depletion, severe rangeland biomass deficit, and emergency livestock feed distributions.",
        source: "NDMA Drought Bulletins 2022"
      },
      "2020": {
        text: "La Niña onset; below-normal rainfall leading to rapid pasture deterioration and early livestock migration.",
        source: "NDMA Early Warning 2020"
      },
      "2016": {
        text: "Weak La Niña failure; poor short rains culminating in February 2017 national drought disaster declaration.",
        source: "NDMA Drought Early Warning 2016"
      },
      "2010": {
        text: "Strong La Niña Horn of Africa drought; catastrophic pasture collapse, acute livestock mortality, and humanitarian emergency response.",
        source: "NDMA / FSNWG Horn of Africa Crisis 2010"
      },
      "2005": {
        text: "Borderline La Niña drought; severe pasture deficit in northern pastoral rangelands with sharp terms-of-trade decline.",
        source: "NDMA Drought Archive 2005"
      },
      "2018": {
        text: "Exceptional long rains floods; widespread riverine and lake basin inundation; severe infrastructure damage.",
        source: "Copernicus GFM SAR / OCHA Flash Update 2018"
      },
      "2024": {
        text: "Severe long rains riverine floods & Mai Mahiu dam breach; 281,000+ displaced, 267 fatalities nationally.",
        source: "ACAPS / Copernicus GFM SAR 2024"
      }
    };

    if (curated[yrStr]) {
      return curated[yrStr];
    }

    if (terc === "Wet") {
      return {
        text: `Elevated precipitation (${Math.round(ptotVal)} mm, +${Math.round(anomVal)}% anomaly); heightened surface runoff, soil saturation, and localized flash flooding risks.`,
        source: "CHIRPS v2.0 / KMSA Historical Archives"
      };
    } else if (terc === "Dry") {
      return {
        text: `Moisture deficit (${Math.round(ptotVal)} mm, ${Math.round(anomVal)}% anomaly); rangeland forage contraction, water pan stress, and heightened agricultural moisture deficit.`,
        source: "CHIRPS v2.0 / NDMA Drought Archive"
      };
    } else {
      return {
        text: `Near-normal precipitation (${Math.round(ptotVal)} mm, ${Math.round(anomVal)}% anomaly); typical baseline pasture productivity and standard crop cycle outcomes.`,
        source: "CHIRPS v2.0 WMO 1991–2020 Baseline"
      };
    }
  }

  // 9. Format Top 3 Precedent Cards
  const top3Dots = dots.slice(0, 3);
  const precedentCardsHTML = top3Dots.map((d, idx) => {
    const tercClass = (d.tercile || "Near").toLowerCase();
    const anomStr = (d.anomaly_pct != null) ? `${d.anomaly_pct > 0 ? '+' : ''}${Math.round(d.anomaly_pct)}%` : "N/A";
    const ptotStr = (d.ptot != null) ? `${Math.round(d.ptot)} mm` : "N/A";
    const impact = getHistoricalImpact(d.year, county, season, d.tercile, d.ptot || climMean, d.anomaly_pct || 0, gfmMap);

    return html`
      <div class="precedent-card">
        <div class="precedent-rank">
          <span>Rank #${idx + 1} &bull; ${d.year}</span>
          <span class="precedent-anom-badge ${tercClass}">${d.tercile} (${anomStr})</span>
        </div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #64748b; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 3px;">
          Observed Total: <strong style="color: #0f172a;">${ptotStr}</strong> (vs ${Math.round(climMean)} mm norm)
        </div>
        <p class="precedent-impact">${impact.text}</p>
        <div class="precedent-cite">
          <strong>Source:</strong> ${impact.source}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  });

  // 10. Multi-Sector Actions Matrix Checklists
  const isWetOutlook = modalCategory === "Wet";
  const isDryOutlook = modalCategory === "Dry";

  const agriChecklist = isWetOutlook ? [
    "Advise construction and reinforcement of soil terraces, contours, and water diversion furrows on sloping arable plots.",
    "Distribute certified early-maturing, water-logging tolerant seed cultivars 4 weeks prior to onset.",
    "Pre-position post-harvest hermetic storage bags and mobile grain drying units across agricultural cooperatives to mitigate high humidity and aflatoxin contamination in maize and pulses."
  ] : isDryOutlook ? [
    "Subsidize certified drought-escaping seed cultivars (sorghum, pearl millet, cowpeas, green grams) 4 weeks before onset.",
    "Promote in-situ rainwater harvesting, micro-basins, and heavy organic crop residue mulching for soil moisture retention.",
    "Advise farmers against late planting or over-reliance on moisture-demanding maize hybrids in marginal agro-ecological zones."
  ] : [
    "Promote standard certified crop seeds and timely land preparation.",
    "Maintain integrated pest management protocols and routine post-harvest handling.",
    "Encourage balanced rotational cropping and standard soil fertility management."
  ];

  const livestockChecklist = isWetOutlook ? [
    "Pre-position livestock vaccines and ring-vaccination biologics against vector-borne Rift Valley Fever (RVF) and CCPP prior to onset.",
    "Stockpile acaricides and vector control fly traps in rangeland pastoral basins.",
    "Designate elevated, well-drained pastoral grazing sanctuaries to protect herds against foot-rot."
  ] : isDryOutlook ? [
    "Activate early commercial destocking vouchers with Kenya Meat Commission (KMC) and local livestock traders before herd body condition deteriorates.",
    "Pre-position supplementary feed blocks, cottonseed cake, and drought mineral supplements at strategic pastoral distribution hubs.",
    "Establish emergency fuel subsidies and rapid repair kits for high-yield strategic community boreholes along livestock trekking corridors."
  ] : [
    "Routine disease surveillance and livestock vaccination across rangelands.",
    "Maintain standard seasonal rotational grazing and pasture deferment protocols.",
    "Routine monitoring of livestock body condition and terms of trade."
  ];

  const waterHealthChecklist = isWetOutlook ? [
    "Elevate shallow well intake heads and protect community borehole solar pump arrays above 100-year flood lines.",
    "Pre-position cholera treatment kits, oral rehydration salts (ORS), and household water purification chemicals (AquaTabs) across rural dispensaries.",
    "Desilt and widen stormwater drainage trunk canals in peri-urban settlement centers."
  ] : isDryOutlook ? [
    "Service emergency generators and submersible pumps on designated strategic drought reserve boreholes.",
    "Mobilize emergency water trucking bowsers for scheduled delivery to schools, health dispensaries, and remote pastoral encampments.",
    "Deepen and rehabilitate community earth pans and sand dams ahead of anticipated seasonal recharge."
  ] : [
    "Routine preventive maintenance on community water distribution infrastructure.",
    "Regular water quality testing and community hygiene promotion.",
    "Maintain strategic municipal water storage reserves."
  ];

  const drmChecklist = isWetOutlook ? [
    "Clear debris from bridge crossings, culverts, and drift causeways along key supply routes (e.g., A2 corridor, rural access feeder roads).",
    "Pre-position emergency non-food relief items (tarpaulins, mosquito nets, cooking sets) in flood-safe forward storage depots.",
    "Identify and gazette elevated community evacuation sanctuaries in coordination with the CDRMC and Kenya Red Cross Society."
  ] : isDryOutlook ? [
    "Scale up county emergency cash transfers and cash-for-work safety net programs (HSNP / social registries) to maintain household purchasing power.",
    "Convene monthly CDRMC inter-agency coordination meetings to monitor terms-of-trade degradation and rangeland biomass depletion.",
    "Activate county emergency contingency funding pursuant to the National Disaster Risk Management Act No. 16 of 2026."
  ] : [
    "Monthly monitoring of KMSA advisories by the County Disaster Risk Management Committee (CDRMC).",
    "Maintain standard county emergency contingency readiness and inter-agency roster.",
    "Periodic drills of early warning dissemination channels."
  ];

  // 11. Proposal Paragraph Text Generator
  const seasonFull = season === "OND" ? "Short Rains (October–December)" : "Long Rains (March–May)";
  const econContextText = isPastoral
    ? `pastoral and agro-pastoral livelihoods (with livestock comprising approximately ${(vopSummary?.pctLivestock || 85).toFixed(0)}% of modeled agricultural capital; MapSPAM/GLW4 nominal 2021 USD basis, excl. camels which represent dominant pastoral wealth in KNBS Census Vol IV)`
    : `smallholder cropping and mixed agricultural systems (with crops representing approximately ${(vopSummary?.pctCrops || 70).toFixed(0)}% of agricultural capital; MapSPAM/GLW4 nominal 2021 USD basis)`;

  const proposalParagraphText = `Climate Rationale Synthesis for ${county} County (${seasonFull}):
According to official Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS 2019 Census Vol IV) data, ${county} County encompasses an enumerated population of ${popStr} residents across ${areaStr} km². The county's rural economy is anchored in ${econContextText}. Under active equatorial ocean dynamics observed by NOAA CPC (antecedent JAS RONI of ${roniDisplay} °C and DMI of ${dmiDisplay} °C), empirical analogue analysis based on standardized Euclidean distance in joint ocean-temperature space indicates that ${topCount} of the ${n} nearest historical analogue seasons (${Math.round((topCount/n)*100)}% [95% CI: ${Math.round(ci.low*100)}%–${Math.round(ci.high*100)}%]) resulted in ${isWetOutlook ? "Above Normal (wetter than 1991–2020 WMO climatological baseline)" : isDryOutlook ? "Below Normal (drier than 1991–2020 WMO climatological baseline)" : "Near Normal"} rainfall, with an empirical mean anomaly of ${meanAnomPct > 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(meanAnomPct)}% against the county 30-year normal (${Math.round(climMean)} mm).

In alignment with the National Disaster Risk Management Act No. 16 of 2026 and County Disaster Risk Management Committee (CDRMC) protocols, anticipatory adaptation financing is urgently justified to ${isWetOutlook ? "pre-position veterinary biologics against vector-borne livestock diseases (Rift Valley Fever, CCPP), reinforce vulnerable arterial transport culverts, and distribute water-logging tolerant certified crop varieties" : isDryOutlook ? "deploy strategic livestock feed supplements and destocking vouchers, service emergency borehole generators, and scale up social registry cash transfers" : "maintain standard agricultural inputs and livestock health surveillance"}. Operational weather advisories must be continuously coordinated through the Kenya Meteorological Service Authority (KMSA) under the Meteorology Act No. 7 of 2026.`;

  // 12. Build and Release Metadata
  const releaseVersion = releaseMeta?.versionDisplay || "v3.8.0";
  const releaseBuild = releaseMeta?.build ? `build ${releaseMeta.build}` : "build 61c3784";
  const releaseVintage = releaseMeta?.dataVintage || "2026-09";
  const generationDate = new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-KE", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" });

  // 13. Assemble Executive Brief DOM
  const briefEl = html`
    <div class="brief-wrapper">
      <!-- Screen-only top action bar -->
      <div class="brief-actions-bar brief-no-print">
        <div class="brief-actions-left">
          <span class="brief-eyebrow-pill">DECISION SUPPORT &bull; CITABLE BRIEF</span>
          <span class="brief-target-tag"><strong>${county} County</strong> &bull; ${season === "OND" ? "Short Rains (OND)" : "Long Rains (MAM)"}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="brief-actions-right">
          <button type="button" class="btn-copy-proposal" onclick="window.copyBriefProposalText ? window.copyBriefProposalText() : null" title="Copy proposal-ready climate rationale paragraph for GCF/AF/CIDP">
            <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path></svg>
            Copy Proposal Rationale
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn-print-brief" onclick="window.printExecutiveBrief ? window.printExecutiveBrief() : window.print()" title="Export or print clean 2-page PDF brief">
            <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><polyline points="6 9 6 2 18 2 18 9"></polyline><path d="M6 18H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h16a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2"></path><rect x="6" y="14" width="12" height="8"></rect></svg>
            Export / Print 2-Page Brief
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- PAGE 1: DIAGNOSIS, PLANETARY SIGNALS & ANALOGUE CONSENSUS -->
      <div class="brief-page brief-page-1">
        <div class="brief-doc-header">
          <div class="brief-header-meta-row">
            <span>AFRICAN AGRICULTURE ADAPTATION ATLAS &bull; KENYA CLIMATE RATIONALE PLATFORM</span>
            <span style="color: #0284c7;">PAGE 1 OF 2 &bull; EXECUTIVE BRIEF</span>
          </div>
          <div class="brief-title-row">
            <h2 class="brief-doc-title">Executive Climate Brief: ${county} County</h2>
            <span class="brief-season-badge">${season === "OND" ? "OND Short Rains" : "MAM Long Rains"} Outlook</span>
          </div>
          <p class="brief-doc-subtitle">Empirical Planetary Ocean Dynamics, Historical Analogue Odds &amp; Operational Decision Precedents</p>
        </div>

        <!-- Administrative Baseline Strip -->
        <div class="brief-admin-strip">
          <div class="admin-col">
            <span class="lbl">County &amp; P-Code</span>
            <span class="val">${county} <small style="color:#64748b; font-weight:normal;">(${selPCode})</small></span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-col">
            <span class="lbl">KNBS 2019 Census Headcount</span>
            <span class="val">${popStr} <small style="color:#64748b; font-weight:normal;">(${totalsPopStr} 2026 proj)</small></span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-col">
            <span class="lbl">Land Area &amp; Density</span>
            <span class="val">${areaStr} km² <small style="color:#64748b; font-weight:normal;">(${densityStr} /km²)</small></span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-col">
            <span class="lbl">Rural Economic Baseline</span>
            <span class="val" style="font-size: 0.76rem;">${econSummary}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-col">
            <span class="lbl">Bimodal Climatology (1991–2020)</span>
            <span class="val">OND: ${Math.round(climOND)} mm | MAM: ${Math.round(climMAM)} mm</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Four Diagnostic KPI Metric Tiles -->
        <div class="brief-kpi-grid">
          <!-- Tile 1: Ocean State -->
          <div class="brief-kpi-card kpi-ocean">
            <div class="kpi-card-header">
              <span class="kpi-icon">🌊</span>
              <span class="kpi-title">Active Planetary Drivers</span>
              <span class="kpi-status-badge ${phaseClass}">${phase}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="kpi-main-metric">
              <div class="sub-metric">
                <span class="driver-label">NOAA CPC RONI (${currentState?.roniSeason || 'JAS 2026'}):</span>
                <span class="driver-val">${roniDisplay} °C</span>
                <span class="trend-tag ${currentState?.roniTrend || 'steady'}">${currentState?.roniTrend || 'steady'} ${currentState?.roniArrow || '→'}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="sub-metric">
                <span class="driver-label">NOAA CPC DMI (${currentState?.dmiMonthYear || 'Sep 2026'}):</span>
                <span class="driver-val">${dmiDisplay} °C</span>
                <span class="trend-tag ${currentState?.dmiTrend || 'steady'}">${currentState?.dmiTrend || 'steady'} ${currentState?.dmiArrow || '→'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p class="kpi-desc">${oceanNarrative}</p>
          </div>

          <!-- Tile 2: KMSA Mandate -->
          <div class="brief-kpi-card kpi-mandate">
            <div class="kpi-card-header">
              <span class="kpi-icon">🏛️</span>
              <span class="kpi-title">Statutory Forecasting Authority</span>
              <span class="kpi-status-badge mandate">Official Voice</span>
            </div>
            <div class="kpi-main-metric">
              <div class="mandate-authority">Kenya Meteorological Service Authority (KMSA)</div>
            </div>
            <p class="kpi-desc">
              Mandated under <strong>Meteorology Act No. 7 of 2026</strong>. This platform provides empirical analogues for adaptation project design; binding operational daily weather warnings and seasonal advisories are issued exclusively by KMSA (<a href="https://meteo.go.ke" target="_blank" rel="noopener">meteo.go.ke</a>) and downscaled by the County Director of Meteorology (CDM).
            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Tile 3: Analogue Consensus Odds -->
          <div class="brief-kpi-card kpi-consensus">
            <div class="kpi-card-header">
              <span class="kpi-icon">🎯</span>
              <span class="kpi-title">Analogue Consensus (${n} Nearest Seasons)</span>
              <span class="kpi-status-badge ${modalCategory.toLowerCase()}">${modalCategory} Odds</span>
            </div>
            <div class="kpi-main-metric">
              <div class="consensus-ratio">
                ${topCount} of ${n} seasons (${Math.round((topCount / n) * 100)}%) were ${modalCategory}
              </div>
              <div class="consensus-ci" style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px;">
                <span>95% Wilson CI: <strong>${Math.round(ci.low * 100)}%–${Math.round(ci.high * 100)}%</strong></span>
                ${skillRPSS ? html`<span class="hindcast-badge" style="font-size: 0.63rem; font-weight: 700; background: #e0f2fe; color: #0369a1; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #bae6fd;">LOOCV: RPSS ${skillRPSS} &bull; ${skillHitPct} Hit</span>` : ''}
              </div>
            </div>
            <p class="kpi-desc">
              Analogue rainfall averaged <strong>${Math.round(meanAnalogueRain)} mm</strong> (${meanAnomPct > 0 ? '+' : ''}${Math.round(meanAnomPct)}% vs county 1991–2020 normal: ${Math.round(climMean)} mm). Distribution: ${counts.Wet || 0} Above Normal (Wet), ${counts.Near || 0} Near Normal, ${counts.Dry || 0} Below Normal (Dry).
            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Tile 4: Compounding Consecutive-Season Risk -->
          <div class="brief-kpi-card kpi-compounding">
            <div class="kpi-card-header">
              <span class="kpi-icon">🔄</span>
              <span class="kpi-title">Consecutive-Season Compounding Dynamics</span>
              <span class="kpi-status-badge ${compoundBadgeClass}">Compound Risk</span>
            </div>
            <div class="kpi-main-metric">
              <div class="compound-transition">Antecedent Transition: ${antecedentSeasonName} &rarr; ${season}</div>
            </div>
            <p class="kpi-desc">${compoundingNarrative}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Section B: Top 3 Historical Analogue Precedents -->
        <div class="brief-precedents-section">
          <div class="section-banner">
            <h3 class="section-title">Top 3 Historical Ocean Analogue Precedents for ${county} County</h3>
            <span class="section-note">Ranked by standardized Euclidean distance in joint ocean-temperature space</span>
          </div>
          <div class="precedents-grid">
            ${precedentCardsHTML}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Screen Page Break Indicator -->
      <div class="brief-page-break-screen brief-no-print">
        <div class="break-line"></div>
        <div class="break-pill">
          <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"></path><polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"></polyline></svg>
          Page 1 End &bull; 2-Page Print / PDF Boundary
        </div>
        <div class="break-line"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- PAGE 2: ANTICIPATORY ACTION MATRIX & PROPOSAL RATIONALE -->
      <div class="brief-page brief-page-2">
        <div class="brief-doc-header">
          <div class="brief-header-meta-row">
            <span>AFRICAN AGRICULTURE ADAPTATION ATLAS &bull; KENYA CLIMATE RATIONALE PLATFORM</span>
            <span style="color: #0284c7;">PAGE 2 OF 2 &bull; ACTION MATRIX &amp; RATIONALE</span>
          </div>
          <div class="brief-title-row">
            <h2 class="brief-doc-title">Anticipatory Action Matrix: ${county} County</h2>
            <span class="brief-season-badge">Operational Leads</span>
          </div>
          <p class="brief-doc-subtitle">Multi-Sector Contingency Triggers Aligned with National Disaster Risk Management Act No. 16 of 2026 (CDRMC Framework)</p>
        </div>

        <!-- Multi-Sector Anticipatory Action Matrix (4 Sectors) -->
        <div class="brief-actions-matrix-grid">
          <!-- Sector 1: Agriculture -->
          <div class="action-sector-card">
            <div class="action-sector-header">
              <span class="sector-icon">🌾</span>
              <div class="sector-meta">
                <h4 class="sector-title">1. Agriculture &amp; Crop Production</h4>

              </div>

        </div>

        <!-- Citable Proposal Climate Rationale Text Block -->
        <div class="brief-proposal-section">
          <div class="proposal-header">
            <span class="proposal-title">Citable Climate Rationale Paragraph (Ready for GCF / AF / CIDP Section B)</span>
            <button type="button" class="btn-copy-inline brief-no-print" onclick="window.copyBriefProposalText ? window.copyBriefProposalText() : null">
              <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path></svg>
              Copy Rationale
            </button>
          </div>
          <div class="proposal-body">
            <p id="briefProposalText">${proposalParagraphText}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Official Provenance, Legal Sign-Off & Vintage -->
        <div class="brief-doc-footer">
          <div>
            <strong>Statutory &amp; Administrative Alignment:</strong> Kenya Meteorological Service Authority (Meteorology Act No. 7 of 2026) &bull; National Disaster Risk Management Act No. 16 of 2026 (CDRMC) &bull; KNBS 2019 Kenya Population &amp; Housing Census Volume IV &bull; KNBS National Agricultural Produce Reports (NAPR 2019–2024).
          </div>
          <div>
            <strong>Scientific Provenance:</strong> NOAA CPC ERSSTv6 / RONI &bull; CHIRPS v2.0 (1981–2025; WMO 1991–2020 30-year climatological normal) &bull; Copernicus GFM Sentinel-1 SAR &bull; JRC GloFAS River Flood Hazard Maps v2.1.
          </div>
          <div>
            <strong>Platform Release:</strong> ${releaseVersion} (${releaseBuild}) &bull; Data Vintage: ${releaseVintage} &bull; Generated: ${generationDate} &bull; African Agriculture Adaptation Atlas (Digital Atlas, CC BY 4.0).
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  host.replaceChildren(briefEl);
  return briefEl;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Variable metadata map: code, label, units, normal-description
rainVarMeta = ({
  "Precipitation": {
    v: "PTOT", unit: "mm", short: "PTOT",
    anomDesc: "mm relative to 1991–2020 WMO standard normal",
    source: "CHIRPS v3 (UCSB/CHC)",
  },
  "Drought index (SPEI-3)": {
    v: "SPEI-03", unit: "z", short: "SPEI03",
    anomDesc: "Standardised Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index (3-month)",
    source: "Vicente-Serrano / CHIRPS v3 derived",
  },
})

varDef = rainVarMeta[climateVar]
varShort = varDef.short
varIsSpei = varDef.v.startsWith("SPEI")
varIsTemp = varDef.v === "TMEAN"
varIsAnom = varIsSpei ? true : rainView.startsWith("Anomaly")

// Download payload: full dataset for the selected variable and year range
rainDownloadRows = {
  const rs = rainActiveSeasons.flatMap((s) => {
    const dataObj = rainSeasonData.get(s);
    if (!dataObj) return [];
    return dataObj.rows.map((r) => ({
      county,
      gaul1_code: selGaul,
      variable: climateVar,
      season: s,
      year: r.year,
      value: r.value,
      clim_1991_2020: dataObj.clim,
      anomaly: varIsSpei ? null : (r.value != null ? r.value - dataObj.clim : null),
      pixel_sd: r.sd,
      ocean_driver: s === "MAM" ? r.wnp : `${r.enso} / ${r.iodPhase}`,
    }));
  });
  return rs;
}

// Fetch seasonal totals for the selected county & year range from chirps_county
rainSeasonData = {
  const yrLo = Math.min(rainYearFrom, rainYearTo);
  const yrHi = Math.max(rainYearFrom, rainYearTo);
  const map = new Map();
  for (const s of rainActiveSeasons) {
    const rows = await dbChirps.query(`
      SELECT year,
             AVG(value_mean) AS val,
             AVG(value_sd)   AS sd
      FROM chirps_county
      WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND variable = '${varDef.v}'
        AND period = '${s}'
        AND year BETWEEN ${yrLo} AND ${yrHi}
      GROUP BY year
      ORDER BY year
    `);
    const climRows = await dbChirps.query(`
      SELECT AVG(value_mean) AS clim
      FROM chirps_county
      WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
        AND variable = '${varDef.v}'
        AND period = '${s}'
        AND year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020
    `);
    const clim = climRows[0] ? climRows[0].clim : (d3.mean(rows, (r) => r.val) || 0);
    const aug = rows.map((r) => {
      const enso = ensoPhaseOND.get(r.year) ?? "Neutral";
      const iodPhase = iodPhaseOND.get(r.year) ?? "Neutral";
      const wnp = wnpPhaseMAM.get(r.year) ?? "Neutral";
      return {year: r.year, value: r.val, sd: r.sd, enso, iodPhase, wnp};
    });
    map.set(s, {rows: aug, clim});
  }
  return map;
}

phaseChips = html``
```
